Requirements:

• Passionate about helping people, especially within healthcare and transportation contexts.

title: Social Media & Brand Content Editor
description:
About the Role:

Position: Social Media & Brand Content Editor

Type: Full-Time / Contract

Location: Remote

Focus: Social Media, Brand Content, Short-Form Video & E-commerce



We are looking for a creative, organized, and trend-aware Social Media & Brand Content Manager to help grow and strengthen our brand across social media and e-commerce channels.



This hands-on creative role combines social media, content creation, video editing, and brand storytelling. You will turn raw footage, product shoots, and creative concepts into engaging content for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Meta, and our website.



The ideal candidate has a strong pulse on social media trends, understands what makes content engaging, and has a strong eye for luxury branding, jewelry, visual storytelling, and high-quality product presentation. They should be able to review raw footage thoughtfully, identify standout moments, and understand pacing, flow, timing, and what makes viewers stop, watch, and engage.



Key Responsibilities:



Edit short-form videos, Reels, TikTok, paid ad creatives, and website/PDP videos designed to increase engagement, clicks, and conversions.



Turn raw footage and brand shoots into polished, engaging social content while maintaining a consistent visual identity.



Create clean, elegant product videos that showcase jewelry, precious metals, gemstones, and details in a premium and accurate way.



Stay up to date with current TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and Meta trends, including editing styles, hooks, sounds, formats, and content opportunities.



Help develop creative concepts, hooks, captions, storylines, and content ideas for social media and e-commerce.



Write or assist with social captions, headlines, hooks, CTAs, and other short-form copy that aligns with the brand voice.



Repurpose long-form shoots, campaigns, interviews, and existing brand assets into multiple pieces of bite-sized content.



Create branded motion graphics, captions, text overlays, transitions, music, and sound design.



Ensure jewelry remains the visual focus and is presented accurately, beautifully, and consistently across all content.



Maintain consistent branding across social media, advertisements, website content, and other digital channels.



Collaborate with directors, producers, photographers, marketing team members, and other creatives to execute the desired creative vision.



Identify opportunities to improve content through stronger hooks, creative concepts, editing styles, pacing, and calls to action.



Organize and maintain video footage, creative assets, graphics, and finished content using Dropbox and other organizational systems.



Manage multiple projects and content deadlines in a fast-paced environment.



What We're Looking For

A strong understanding of current social media trends and short-form content.



Strong video editing skills and the ability to turn raw footage into polished, engaging content.



A good instinct for identifying standout moments, strong hooks, natural pacing, flow, rhythm, and visual storytelling.



Someone who genuinely reviews and understands the footage they are given rather than relying solely on automated or AI-generated edits.



AI tools are a plus and can be used to improve efficiency, but strong creative judgment and hands-on editing skills are essential.



Experience creating content for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, paid social ads, and e-commerce/PDP pages.



Strong understanding of social media formats, hooks, storytelling, trends, and platform-specific content requirements.



Strong creative eye with an understanding of luxury, fashion, jewelry, beauty, or other visually driven brands preferred.



Ability to color correct and grade footage, including exposure, contrast, white balance, skin tones, precious metals, and gemstones.



Strong sense of timing, pacing, rhythm, and visual storytelling.



Ability to maintain a consistent brand aesthetic across different types of content.



Comfortable working with programs such as Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut, Canva, and similar creative tools.



Knowledge or experience with AI tools such as DaVinci, ChatGPT, Weavy, Gemini, and other AI-powered creative or productivity tools.



Ability to collaborate with directors, producers, photographers, and marketing teams to bring creative concepts to life.



Strong organizational and project-management skills with the ability to manage multiple deadlines.



Understanding of social media formats, aspect ratios, resolutions, frame rates, compression, and platform requirements.



Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and adapting quickly to changing trends and priorities.



Organized, proactive, detail-oriented, and able to consistently meet deadlines.



Familiar with Dropbox and digital asset organization.



Strong written and verbal communication skills.



Ability to work independently while also taking direction and incorporating feedback.



Portfolio Requirement:



IMPORTANT: Please include a link to your portfolio with sample edited videos, social media content, brand content, or other relevant creative work and your updated CV.



A portfolio is required for the hiring process, and applications without a portfolio link may not be considered.

title: Internal Payroll Coordinator (Remote)
description:
This is a remote position.



Please review the following eligibility requirement before applying:

Have you lived or worked in the United States?



OR



Have you physically worked in the United States?



OR



Have you previously participated in the InterExchange Work Program with the United States?



If you answered YES to at least one of the questions above, then this is the opportunity for you.



​

We are looking for an Internal Payroll Coordinator to manage and coordinate the company side of the payroll process and serve as the primary operational link between internal teams and our third-party payroll provider.



This role supports the full payroll cycle, including payroll preparation and validation, processing coordination, payment execution, reconciliation, reporting, and issue resolution.



The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, organized, comfortable working with numbers and large volumes of information, and able to manage strict recurring deadlines. This is a coordination and control role rather than a position focused primarily on manually calculating payroll.



Key responsibilities include:



Maintain and coordinate payroll-related employee and worker information.

Collect and validate time, attendance, pay changes, bonuses, reimbursements, deductions, and payroll adjustments.

Follow up with supervisors and internal teams to ensure payroll information is complete and approved.

Submit accurate and authorized payroll information within established deadlines.

Coordinate with the third-party payroll provider throughout each payroll cycle.

Review preliminary payroll reports for errors, missing workers, unusual amounts, and other discrepancies.

Coordinate corrections and prepare payroll for management approval.

Monitor payroll execution and confirm approved payroll has been processed.

Review and coordinate the resolution of failed, rejected, delayed, or incorrect payments.

Reconcile completed payroll against approved source information and provider reports.

Maintain payroll reports, approvals, reconciliation records, and supporting documentation.

Coordinate payroll-related employee and worker inquiries.

Assist with payroll accounting, reporting, documentation, and process improvements.





Requirements

Must have lived or worked in the United States.

OR must have previously participated in the InterExchange Work Program with the United States.

Experience in accounting support, payroll coordination, finance administration, data processing, or a related role.

Basic accounting and data-encoding skills.

Strong numerical accuracy and attention to detail.

Ability to review data and identify missing, inconsistent, or unusual information.

Good organizational, reconciliation, and problem-solving skills.

Ability to manage recurring deadlines and follow up on outstanding requirements.

Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

Ability to coordinate professionally with employees, managers, internal departments, and external service providers.

Ability to handle confidential payroll, compensation, banking, and employee information responsibly.

Ability to work independently in a structured remote environment.

Comfortable using Microsoft Outlook, OneDrive, Microsoft 365/Office applications, spreadsheets, online collaboration tools, and payroll, timekeeping, or accounting systems.

Preferred Qualifications:



Educational background in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.

Previous experience with payroll, timekeeping, accounting, or financial systems.

Experience coordinating with a third-party payroll provider.

Experience supporting U.S.-based operations or a distributed workforce.

Familiarity with payroll reconciliation, payroll reports, and financial documentation.

Experience working with high-volume employee or worker records.

Experience with payroll platforms is an advantage; however, the ability to quickly learn new systems is also important.



Benefits

Competitive compensation based on experience and qualifications.

Fully remote work environment.

Structured payroll processes and clearly defined responsibilities.

Opportunity to gain experience supporting U.S.-based payroll operations.

Long-term opportunity within a growing organization.

Exposure to accounting, payroll controls, reconciliation, and financial operations.

Opportunity to develop experience across the full payroll cycle.

Collaboration with Accounting, HR, Operations, Management, and external payroll providers.

Tiger Air & Heating is a family-owned HVAC company serving residential and commercial customers throughout the Dallas-Fort Worth area. We’re looking for a reliable and organized Customer Service Representative (CSR) / Dispatcher to join our team.

What You’ll Do

- Answer inbound customer calls professionally

- Schedule and confirm service appointments

- Dispatch technicians and coordinate their schedules

- Keep customers updated on arrival times

- Handle customer questions and concerns

- Communicate with technicians throughout the day

- Keep customer and job notes accurate in our CRM

- Make outbound calls and follow up with customers when needed



What We’re Looking For



Required:

- Excellent spoken and written English

- Strong customer service and communication skills

- Good organization and multitasking skills

- Reliable high-speed internet

- Quiet home office

- Backup internet and power

- Availability to work U.S. Central Time hours



Preferred:

- CSR, dispatcher, call center, or scheduling experience

- Experience in HVAC, plumbing, electrical, or other home services

- Familiarity with CRM or scheduling software

Compensation

- Competitive pay based on experience

- Performance bonuses available

- Long-term opportunity with a growing family-owned company



Application Process



Step 1 – Written Questions



Please answer:

- Tell us about your customer service or dispatch experience.

- What software or systems have you used?

- What hours are you available to work in CST?

- Tell us about a difficult customer you handled and how you resolved the situation.

- What is your internet speed, and do you have backup internet and power?

Customer: “My AC stopped working and my house is 85 degrees. I called earlier and nobody called me back. What is going on?!”

- Professionalism

- Confidence

- Empathy

- Problem-solving

What We Value

- Fast communication

- Attention to detail

- Calmness under pressure

- Positive attitude

- Teamwork

- Willingness to learn



How to Apply

- Customer service roleplay



We’re looking for someone who wants to grow with Tiger Air & Heating and become a dependable part of our team.

title: Social Media Strategist (WFH / Remote)
description:
Full-time | Remote Setup/Work from Home

Working hours: 9am to 6pm SGT

Salary: SGD 800 - 1,200



About the role

Trident Digital is one of the fastest growing marketing agencies for financial advisors and real estate leaders in Singapore. Our clients are top producers in their field, working in trust-based markets where the people who win are the ones their audience already knows, likes and trusts before the first conversation ever happens. That's what they pay us to build.



This role owns that side of the business. You'll be the strategist behind our clients' brands: d
 what each client should stand for, what angles will make their market remember them, and what content gets made to build that authority month after month. Then you'll sit in front of the client and defend it. We're not hiring a content scheduler. We're hiring someone who can look at a financial advisor's or real estate agent's brand and say "here's why nobody remembers you, and here's what we're doing instead."



What the setup looks like

You'll work closely with our strategy team, ops manager, projects manager and creative team. Each client gets a real strategy, not a recycled template. Main platforms are
 and Instagram, with TikTok and YouTube as secondary. Market is Singapore. Niches are financial advisory and real estate — trust-based industries where the brand does the heavy lifting long before any pitch. Depending on the client, the end goal is winning clients or recruiting new team members, and your job is building the kind of presence that makes either one easier.



What you'll do

• Turn each client's positioning, audience and goals into a clear content strategy: what they stand for, what angles to hit, what to make

• Lead client calls as the strategy contact: present directions, run brainstorms, handle pushback, and keep clients aligned and confident

• Direct the creative team: give direction clear enough to execute without a second meeting, and review outputs against the strategy

• Review performance: spot which angles and formats are working, kill what isn't, and adjust the plan based on evidence

• Keep every client's strategy on track: make sure what gets produced actually follows the direction set, and flag drift or gaps early before they cost results



How you'll be measured

Brand growth and client confidence. Clients whose authority and presence visibly grow — stronger positioning, growing reach, content their market actually engages with and remembers. And clients who renew because they can feel the strategy working. You'll run insights calls with clients to review whether the strategy is delivering — and adjust when it isn't. If you'd rather be measured on outcomes than on how many posts went out, you'll enjoy this.



You'll do well here if you

• Think in brand outcomes first: you ask "what does this client need to be known for?" before you ask "what should we post?"

• Can walk into a client call, present a direction, and hold your ground when it's challenged—with reasoning, not stubbornness

• Study why a piece of content worked, not just that it worked

• Give creatives feedback that makes the work better, not just different

• Communicate proactively. Clients and the team should never have to chase you for an update



This is not for you if you

• Think strategy means a content calendar with theme days

• Have freelance clients or side hustles competing for your focus. This has to be your main thing, because split attention shows in the work

• Chase trends for their own sake. A trending format that doesn't fit a financial advisor's positioning is a distraction, not a strategy

• Avoid client-facing pressure. Presenting, defending and realigning is half this job



No hard feelings either way. We'd rather both sides know now.



Bonus points

• You've built content strategies for service professionals or personal brands

• Bigger bonus: financial advisors, insurance or real estate specifically

• Biggest bonus: you've done it for the Singapore market



What you get

• Real ownership of strategy, working directly with the founder and clients — not three layers removed from the decisions

• Your strategies run on real accounts with real stakes. You see whether your thinking works, fast

• A team that invests in growth: internal masterminds, sponsored courses, and overseas team trips

• Room to grow into a head of strategy role as the agency scales



How to apply

 
 with the subject line:

Your Next Strategist - [Your Full Name]



Your email should include:

• Cover letter: years of experience in content or social media strategy and how you think you can contribute to Trident Digital

• Updated CV/Resume

• Portfolio: 2 to 3 accounts or campaigns you've shaped the strategy for, with a few sentences on each explaining what the strategy was and what it achieved

• One short exercise: find one financial advisor or real estate agent posting content on Instagram or TikTok (any market). In a few lines, tell us what's holding their brand back and the first thing you'd change. We're looking at how you think

• Expected salary in SGD



Important Note: Incomplete applications will not be considered. The exercise is part of the screening. It tells us more than a CV can.

title: Business Development Associate (WFH / Remote)
description:
Trident Digital | Singapore

Full-time | Remote (Work from Home)

Working hours: Singapore hours (9am–6pm)

Salary: SGD 300 base + performance bonus (total est. SGD 500–1,000 with commissions)



About the role

Trident Digital is one of the fastest growing marketing agencies for financial advisors and real estate leaders in Singapore. Every client we work with started as a conversation someone had to start. This role starts those conversations.

You'll be the front end of our business development: reaching out to potential clients, keeping conversations warm, and making sure no opportunity slips through the cracks. It's a hands-on, execution-focused role — and it's how careers in sales and business development actually begin. Not with a fancy title, but with learning how to open doors, day after day, and getting paid more when more of them open.

If you're organised, consistent, and not afraid to message a stranger, keep reading.



What the setup looks like

You'll work closely with our BD lead and the founder — which means you'll see, up close, how deals actually move from first message to signed client. Outreach runs mainly through LinkedIn, Instagram and email. Prospects are financial advisors and real estate leaders in Singapore. You'll follow proven outreach processes and scripts to start, with real room to improve them as you learn what works.



What You’ll Do

• Reach out to potential clients daily across LinkedIn, Instagram, email and other platforms

• Start conversations and build genuine initial connections — not spray-and-pray spam

• Follow up consistently so leads stay warm and conversations keep moving forward

• Keep the pipeline clean: every prospect tracked, every response logged, nothing dropped

• Support the BD lead with simple decks, proposals and client coordination when needed



How you'll be measured

Conversations started, replies earned, and meetings booked for the BD lead. Your commissions are tied to results, so the better you get at this, the more you earn — and you'll see your numbers every week. If you like the idea of your pay reflecting your output instead of just your hours, you'll enjoy this.



You'll do well here if you

• Show up consistently. Outreach rewards the person who does it every day, not the person who does it brilliantly once a week

• Write like a human. Your messages should read like a real person reaching out, not a template blast

• Don't take silence personally. Most people won't reply — the ones who do are why the job exists

• Sweat the small stuff: names spelled right, follow-ups on time, tracker always current

• Want to grow into a real sales or business development career, and see this as the ground floor of it



This is not for you if you

• Need every day to feel new and exciting. The core of this job is repetition done well

• Get discouraged after a week of no's. Resilience isn't optional here, it's the job

• Have freelance work or side hustles competing for your focus. This has to be your main thing

• See outreach as beneath you. The founder of this company did it too. It's how businesses get built

No hard feelings either way. We'd rather both sides know now.



Bonus points

• You've done outreach, sales or lead generation before, even informally

• You're familiar with LinkedIn, Instagram or CRM tools

• You've handled high message volume without letting quality slip

• Fresh grads are welcome to apply. We care more about consistency and hunger than years of experience.



What you get

• Direct exposure to the founder and BD lead — you learn how deals are won, not just how messages are sent

• Commissions that grow with your results, so your ceiling is set by your effort

• A team that invests in growth: internal masterminds, sponsored courses, and overseas team trips

• A clear path into business development and sales roles as the agency scales



How to Apply

 
 with the subject line:

Your Next Business Development Associate - [Your Full Name]

Your email should include:

• Cover letter: a bit about yourself and why this role fits you

• Updated CV/Resume

• One short exercise: write the first outreach message you'd send to a financial advisor on LinkedIn to start a conversation about working with a marketing agency. Keep it short — the kind of message you'd actually send. We're looking at how you write and how you think

• Expected salary in SGD



Important Note: Incomplete applications will not be considered. The exercise is part of the screening. It tells us more than a CV can.

s and WhatsApp messages. Your work runs on live campaigns with real budgets, and you’ll know within days whether it worked. If that excites you, keep reading.

Bonus points

What you get

 with the subject line: 

Your Next Copywriter - [Your Full Name]

 should include:

title: Cold Caller / Appointment Setter
description:
We're hiring appointment setters to book qualified discovery calls for our virtual assistant services with US business owners. Your job is to get decision-makers on the phone, spark real interest in offloading work to a VA, and book them into our sales calendar.



Leads are provided. You'll work through company-supplied lead lists, and you're welcome to source your own if you want to expand your pipeline (and your earnings).



This role rewards quality bookings, not busy work. We're not looking for someone who slams the calendar with meetings that never happen. We want appointments that turn into real conversations with real prospects.



What You'll Do





• Work through company-provided lead lists by phone



• Source your own leads when you want to expand your pipeline



• Cold call US business owners in English — live, without a script to hide behind



• Navigate front desks, administrative assistants, and gatekeepers effortlessly to reach actual decision-makers



• Apply core consultative sales fundamentals to uncover pain points, handle objections, and pitch value on the spot



• Qualify prospects against our criteria before booking anything



• Book discovery calls, confirm them, and chase no-shows to a reschedule



• Follow up on every warm lead until you get a clear yes or no



• Log every call, outcome, and note in our CRM cleanly enough for someone else to pick up cold



• Report daily on activity: dials made, conversations had, meetings booked



What We're Looking For



Required:





• Strong foundation in sales fundamentals — you know how to build quick rapport, uncover operational bottlenecks, handle knee-jerk objections, and control the conversation



• Proven gatekeeper navigation skills — you know how to bypass screens, sound like an authority, and get transferred directly to the owner/CEO



• Tremendous spoken English. You'll be calling US business owners live. A clear accent is fine — hesitation, filler, and broken phrasing are not



• Real cold calling experience — proven dials, proven bookings



• Honesty about your numbers. We track everything on our side — dials, connects, show-up rates. Padded activity ends the engagement immediately. If you report it, it needs to be real



• Self-driven. You don't need a manager standing over you to keep dialing. You already know what needs to happen when the phone goes quiet



• Comfortable with rejection and picking the phone back up



• Reliable internet, quiet workspace, clean-audio headset



• Full availability during 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST



Nice to have:





• Experience booking appointments for agencies, staffing firms, or B2B services



• Experience with dialers (Ricochet, Quo, Aircall, or similar) and CRMs (GoHighLevel, Zoho, HubSpot)



• LinkedIn outreach experience to warm up cold prospects



• A track record with actual numbers attached — dials per day, connect rate, booking rate, show rate



Hours & Schedule





• Full-time: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST (Monday to Friday)



• We expect full-time focus on active dialing, pipeline follow-ups, and calendar management — not just idle logged-in time



Compensation





• Base Pay: $50 weekly base salary



• Performance Commission: Competitive commission paid for every qualified discovery call where the prospect actually shows up and joins the call



• Payout structure rewards qualified shows over empty bookings — uncapped earning potential for top performers



How to Apply



Send your application to: 



Include:





1. Updated CV



2. Short video intro in English — introduce yourself, share your favorite strategy for bypassing gatekeepers, and walk us through your best cold calling results with real numbers (dials, meetings booked, show rate)



3. Your typical daily activity — how many dials you make, connect rate, booking rate



4. Confirmation that you can commit full-time to 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST



Applications without a video intro will not be reviewed.

title: Experienced U.S. Funding Specialist VA | Business & Personal Funding
description:
We’re ClearPath Approvals, a U.S.-based credit and approval company located in New York, and we’re looking for someone who REALLY knows funding.



Please read that again because this is important:



We are NOT looking for a beginner VA who watched videos about business funding.



We are NOT looking for someone who only knows how to look at a credit report and tell us, “This client is funding ready.”



We need someone who has actually helped REAL clients get APPROVED.



We’re looking for someone with recent hands-on experience with U.S. personal and business funding — credit cards, 0% APR business cards, lines of credit, personal loans, business loans, credit unions, banks, etc.



You should understand the process from beginning to end:



Review client → Build funding strategy → Choose lender/product → Prepare application → Apply → Follow up → Handle pending/reconsideration → Get result



WHAT WE REALLY NEED



You should know how to look at a client’s complete situation and figure out the best funding strategy.



That means understanding things like:



• Credit profile

• Utilization

• Existing credit limits

• Recent inquiries

• Banking relationships

• Personal income

• Business revenue

• Business age

• Business structure

• Personal guarantees

• Documentation

• Lender requirements

• Application sequencing



We don’t want someone randomly applying everywhere.



We want someone who can explain WHY we should approach Bank A before Bank B, what product makes sense, what could hurt the approval, and when we should STOP and not submit another application.



RECENT APPROVALS MATTER



If you’ve been doing this recently, we want to hear about your results.



We will ask you about at least 3 recent funding approvals you personally worked on, preferably within the last 3–6 months.



You should be able to explain:



• What type of funding it was

• Approximate approval amount

• Bank/lender or type of institution

• Personal or business funding

• What YOU personally did

• Why that lender/product was chosen

• Whether it went pending or needed reconsideration

• Approximate date of approval



Redacted screenshots or other proof of recent approvals are a BIG PLUS.



Please remove all private client information before sending anything.



BANK CONTACTS / RELATIONSHIPS



This is also a BIG PLUS.



If you already have legitimate professional relationships with U.S. bankers, business bankers, relationship managers, branch managers, loan officers, credit union representatives or funding partners, tell us.



We’re very interested in someone who has actually built relationships in the funding industry — not someone who just has a list of bank phone numbers.



Do NOT send anyone’s private contact information in your first application. Just explain the types of relationships you have and how you’ve used them professionally.



APPLICATION EXPERIENCE



We need somebody who knows how to properly prepare and work a funding application.



You should understand what lenders are looking for and what information matters on an application.



Everything submitted for our clients must be truthful and supported by the client’s real information.



We DO NOT falsify income, revenue, employment, business information or documents to get approvals.



The goal is to use REAL information + GOOD strategy + lender knowledge + proper timing to give the client the strongest legitimate opportunity for approval.



PENDING APPLICATION? WE NEED YOU TO KNOW WHAT TO DO NEXT.



If an application goes pending, we don’t want someone who just says, “Let’s wait.”



We want someone who understands how to investigate what’s happening, determine whether documents or verification are needed, communicate with the bank when authorized, handle legitimate reconsideration when available, follow up and track the final result.



ABOUT THE POSITION



This will start as a part-time position.



We operate in New York on EASTERN TIME.



You do not have to work every New York business hour, but you MUST have meaningful overlap with U.S. Eastern business hours because banks, clients and reconsideration departments operate during those hours.



You’ll also be working with our ClearPath Approvals platform and helping us improve our funding workflow.



As we grow this side of the company, there is an opportunity for the right person to grow into a larger Funding Manager / Funding Operations role.



HOW TO APPLY



I don’t want a long generic cover letter.



Start your message with:



FUNDING FIRST — EVIDENCE FIRST



Then answer these questions:



1. How many years have you personally worked with U.S. personal or business funding?



2. Tell me about your 3 most recent funding approvals. Give me the approximate date, lender/product, approval amount and exactly what YOU did.



3. What is the largest approval you personally helped a client obtain?



4. Which U.S. banks, credit unions, card issuers and lenders have you personally worked with during the last 12 months?



5. If I give you a funding-ready client tomorrow, how do you d
 where to apply FIRST?



6. Tell me about a recent application that went pending or was denied. What did you do next? Did you handle reconsideration?



7. Do you currently have professional relationships with bankers, relationship managers, loan officers, credit union representatives or funding partners? Tell me about the TYPE of relationships you have. Do not send their private information.



8. What types of funding have you personally worked with? Business cards? 0% APR? Personal cards? Personal loans? Business loans? Lines of credit? Credit unions?



9. What information do you review BEFORE submitting or recommending an application?



10. How do you prevent unnecessary hard inquiries and avoid applying blindly?



11. What days and hours can you work in U.S. EASTERN TIME (New York time)?



12. Last question — and this one matters:



I give you a client with strong personal credit, low utilization, established revolving accounts, limited recent inquiries, an established business, business banking and documented revenue.



Don’t just tell me, “They’re funding ready.”



Walk me through what YOU would actually do next.



What else do you need to know?



How would you choose the first lender/product?



How would you determine the application order?



What would make you STOP and not submit an application?



What would you do if the application went pending?

title: Operations & Growth Manager — The NYC Classifieds
description:
Remote | Philippines | Full-Time | Marketplace Growth & Promotion

The opportunity

The NYC Classifieds is built.

Now we need someone who can make New York City know it exists.

We are hiring an Operations & Growth Manager whose primary responsibility is to drive:

SIGNUPS. LISTINGS. BUSINESSES. USERS. ENGAGEMENT. GROWTH.

This is not a traditional administrative position.

This person will actively promote the platform, conduct outreach, build relationships, manage social media, communicate with users, collect feedback, identify opportunities, and work directly with the founder and development team to continually improve the product.

Visit the platform before applying:



I confirmed the site is live. The current platform is 100% free, built specifically for NYC, covers all five boroughs and 126+ neighborhoods, and currently says it will officially go live after reaching 10,000 signups. Users are geo-verified using a live selfie and GPS at their NYC address. The NYC Classifieds

It already includes 12 classifieds categories, 220+ subcategories, direct messaging, saved searches and alerts, The Porch community, and a free local business directory. The NYC Classifieds

The product exists. Your job is to build the audience.

Your #1 job: Get people signed up

Every day, you should wake up thinking:

How many New Yorkers can I bring onto this platform today?

You will:

- Conduct direct outreach every day

- Recruit individual users

- Recruit NYC businesses

- Drive new registrations

- Encourage users to create listings

- Recruit businesses into the free directory

- Build activity within marketplace categories

- Follow up with interested users who don't complete registration

- Develop relationships with NYC communities and organizations

- Find partnerships

- Identify creative ways to acquire users without depending on paid advertising

- Track which outreach channels actually generate registrations

- Re-engage inactive users

- Help build enough momentum to reach the initial 10,000-user launch target

You will be measured by results, not by how busy you appear.

Own the social media

The social-media accounts have already been created.

Now somebody needs to make them matter.

You will manage and grow them through:

- Daily content

- Interesting listings

- NYC stories

- Business spotlights

- Neighborhood content

- User-generated content

- Community engagement

- Strategic commenting

- Direct outreach

- Partnerships

- Short-form video

- Category promotion

- Creative campaigns

We're not interested in meaningless follower counts.

We want:

SOCIAL → VISIT → SIGNUP → LISTING → ENGAGEMENT

Build both sides of the marketplace

A marketplace doesn't work because someone built a beautiful website.

It works when there are enough people on both sides.

For every category, you should be asking:

Who has the supply?

Who has the demand?

How do I get both onto NYC Classifieds?

Housing needs listings and renters.

Jobs need employers and candidates.

Services need providers and customers.

For Sale needs sellers and buyers.

The business directory needs NYC businesses and people searching for them.

Your responsibility is to help create marketplace liquidity.

Talk to users constantly

You will become one of the closest people in the company to our users.

Ask them:

- Why did you sign up?

- Why didn't you finish signing up?

- Why didn't you post?

- What confused you?

- What do you love?

- What feels unnecessary?

- What category is missing?

- What would make you return tomorrow?

- What would make you tell someone else about NYC Classifieds?

Then turn those conversations into actionable information.

Help direct product development

You don't need to code.

You do need to understand the product extremely well.

You'll work with the founder and developers to:

- Identify bugs

- Find friction

- Organize user feedback

- Recommend improvements

- Document problems clearly

- Prioritize feature requests

- Coordinate development updates

- Test new releases

- Verify that fixes actually solve the original problem

- Maintain a growth/product priority list

You're the bridge:

USERS → OPERATIONS → FOUNDER → DEVELOPMENT

Don't send the developer:

“Someone doesn't like signup.”



Bring us:

“Eight users abandoned verification at the same step this week. Here's exactly what happened, screenshots, what they told me, and what I think we should change.”



That's the standard.

What success looks like

Your scoreboard will include:

New registrations

New listings

Active users

Businesses onboarded

Outreach → signup conversion

Social → signup conversion

Returning users

Marketplace activity

User feedback

Product improvements shipped

Progress toward 10,000 users

We want someone who gets excited watching those numbers move.

Who we're looking for

You need to be:

- Aggressive about growth

- Extremely proactive

- Fast

- Persistent

- Confident

- Creative

- Comfortable messaging strangers

- Comfortable speaking with American users and businesses

- Excellent in English

- Social-media savvy

- Comfortable with technology

- Organized

- Analytical

- Able to work independently

- Comfortable working directly with developers

- Comfortable being measured by results

- Willing to experiment

- Willing to hear “no”

- Willing to follow up again

- Excited about building something from the beginning

Marketplace, community-management, sales, business-development, social-media, startup, customer-success, product-operations or digital-marketing experience can help.

But I care considerably more about what you're capable of doing now than what's written on your résumé.

Do not apply if...

You want to wait for work to arrive.

You dislike outreach.

You think posting three times per week is a growth strategy.

You need someone to tell you what to do every hour.

You don't follow up.

You're afraid of rejection.

You measure your performance by hours worked instead of outcomes.

You want to maintain something somebody else already grew.

This job is about building.

What we're building

Our ambition for The NYC Classifieds is enormous.

We believe this can become a major classifieds and local-community platform, beginning with New York City and ultimately capable of expanding far beyond it.

The platform is designed around a simple idea:

FREE. REAL. LOCAL. VERIFIED.

It's 100% free—no listing fees, premium tiers or paywalls—and is built specifically around NYC rather than being a national platform with an NYC filter. The NYC Classifieds

Every user is geo-verified.

Every NYC neighborhood can have its own marketplace and community.

There is a complete classifieds marketplace, The Porch community, direct messaging, search and alerts, and a free business directory. The NYC Classifieds

We believe this has the potential to become something very large.

Your opportunity is to help prove it.

Forget the résumé.

I don't want one.

I don't want a cover letter.

I don't want an AI-generated application explaining that you're “hardworking and detail-oriented.”

Your application is your video.

Go through the website first:



Then record a 2–5 minute video and sell me on why you should be the person responsible for growing this brand.

Tell me:

- What do you think of the platform?

- What opportunity do you see?

- What would you do first?

- How would you get our first major wave of signups?

- What would you do with our social accounts?

- How would you recruit businesses?

- How would you build individual marketplace categories?

- What would your first 7 days look like?

- What would you accomplish in your first 30 days?

- What would you change or improve after reviewing the website?

- Why should I trust you with this brand?

Most importantly, answer:

“If I give you The NYC Classifieds tomorrow, what are you going to do with it?”

Send your video directly to Jeff on WhatsApp

+1 (212)
Send your name + your video.

That's it.

No résumé required.

No cover letter required.

Show me how you think. Show me your energy. Show me your ideas. And sell me on why I should give you the opportunity to help build this.

title: Senior Bookkeeper / Ecommerce Accounting Specialist
description:
Senior Bookkeeper – Ecommerce & Inventory

Full-Time | Remote | Philippines



About Synergy Wetsuits



Synergy Wetsuits is a global triathlon and endurance-sports company based in Minden, Nevada, USA. We sell through Shopify, Amazon, wholesale partners, teams, events, and international markets.



We're looking for an experienced Senior Bookkeeper to take ownership of our day-to-day bookkeeping, reconciliations, and month-end accounting processes.



This is a true senior-level position. We're looking for someone with at least 5+ years of substantial bookkeeping/accounting experience. who can bring strong accounting knowledge, sound judgment, and real-world experience to the team from day one.



We'll teach you Synergy—our business, systems, and company-specific processes. We're looking for you to bring the bookkeeping expertise.



The right person will be comfortable independently managing the books, understanding how transactions flow through the financial statements, troubleshooting reconciliation and posting issues, and recognizing when something needs attention. We also want someone who brings ideas to the table and can recommend better accounting practices and processes based on their experience.



You'll work closely with our Finance & Operations Director and Operations Manager as an important part of our finance and operations team.



What You'll Be Responsible For



Daily & Weekly Accounting



You'll take ownership of keeping our financial records accurate and current throughout the month, including:



- Process and review bank and credit card activity

- Maintain accurate transaction coding and supporting documentation

- Review Shopify sales, deposits, refunds, fees, and payment activity

- Review Amazon accounting activity and reconciliations

- Monitor Airwallex and other payment accounts

- Reconcile bank, credit card, payment processor, and clearing accounts

- Review accounting integrations and posting activity

- Research and resolve reconciliation differences

- Prepare and review journal entries

- Review account activity for accuracy and unusual items

- Maintain organized accounting records and supporting schedules

- Work with internal team members and outside support partners to resolve accounting or integration issues



We operate an inventory-based ecommerce business with multiple sales channels, payment platforms, and financial accounts, so strong reconciliation and problem-solving skills are important.



Month-End Close



Our target is to complete month-end close by the second Thursday of the following month.



The Senior Bookkeeper will play a key role in making sure the books are maintained throughout the month so that closing is organized, accurate, and timely.



Responsibilities include:



- Complete bank and credit card reconciliations

- Reconcile payment processors and clearing accounts

- Review outstanding and unreconciled transactions

- Confirm ecommerce activity has been recorded correctly

- Review Balance Sheet and P&L accounts for accuracy

- Review inventory and COGS activity

- Prepare necessary journal entries

- Research and resolve discrepancies

- Maintain supporting schedules and documentation

- Provide clear notes and explanations for management review

- Complete assigned month-end responsibilities on schedule



We use Asana to manage our daily, weekly, and monthly accounting processes, deadlines, and SOPs.



What “Senior” Means to Us



We're looking for more than years on a résumé.



A Senior Bookkeeper at Synergy should be able to:



- Independently manage day-to-day bookkeeping and reconciliations

- Understand accrual accounting and how transactions affect the P&L and Balance Sheet

- Prepare appropriate journal entries without step-by-step instruction

- Manage complex bank, credit card, payment processor, and clearing account reconciliations

- Understand inventory and COGS accounting

- Take ownership of the bookkeeping side of month-end close

- Review account activity and recognize inconsistencies or unusual transactions

- Research accounting discrepancies and determine the appropriate treatment

- Troubleshoot accounting integration and posting issues

- Maintain clean supporting schedules and documentation

- Know when an issue should be escalated before making a change

- Recommend stronger accounting processes, controls, or workflows when appropriate

- Clearly explain accounting issues and recommendations to management



We value someone who can look at an issue and say:



"Here's what I found, here's the accounting impact, and here's what I recommend.”



Minimum Qualifications



- 5+ years of professional bookkeeping/accounting experience required

- Demonstrated experience operating independently at a senior bookkeeper level

- Strong QuickBooks experience

- Strong accrual accounting knowledge

- Advanced bank and credit card reconciliation experience

- Payment processor and clearing account reconciliation experience

- Month-end closing experience

- Balance Sheet and P&L review experience

- Strong journal entry experience

- Inventory and COGS accounting experience

- Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

- Excellent written and verbal English

- Ability to independently manage responsibilities with limited supervision

- Experience working with US-based companies strongly preferred



A bachelor's degree in accounting or finance is welcome but not required. Depth of experience, accounting knowledge, judgment, and problem-solving ability are more important to us than the degree itself.



Systems & Experience That Are a Big Plus



Experience with the following is highly valuable:



- QuickBooks Enterprise Desktop

- QuickBooks Online

- Shopify

- Amazon Seller Central

- Webgility or similar ecommerce accounting integrations

- Airwallex

- Ecommerce accounting

- Inventory-based businesses

- Multi-currency transactions

- International businesses

- Sales tax accounting

- Asana



Direct experience with ecommerce and inventory accounting is strongly preferred.



Who Will Do Well in This Role



We're looking for someone who takes pride in keeping clean, accurate books and enjoys figuring out how the numbers fit together.



You should be organized, dependable, analytical, and comfortable taking ownership of your work. You should also be willing to ask questions, collaborate with the team, and contribute your own accounting expertise when you see an opportunity to improve something.



We don't expect you to know Synergy's business on day one. We do expect you to arrive with the accounting foundation and experience expected of a Senior Bookkeeper.



We're looking for someone who wants to become a trusted, long-term member of our team.



Work Schedule



This is a full-time, 40-hour-per-week position, Monday through Friday.



The workday begins at 12:00 PM Pacific Time (US) and runs for an 8-hour shift.



Depending on US daylight saving time, this is approximately:



- 3:00 AM–11:00 AM Philippine Time during Pacific Daylight Time

- 4:00 AM–12:00 PM Philippine Time during Pacific Standard Time



This schedule provides strong overlap with our US team while allowing the workday to finish around midday in the Philippines.



Applicants must be comfortable maintaining this schedule and with the one-hour seasonal adjustment when US daylight saving time changes.



About Synergy



Synergy Wetsuits has been part of the triathlon community since the 1990s. We design and sell performance wetsuits, swimskins, apparel, and accessories for endurance athletes.



We're a small international team, which means each person has an opportunity to make a meaningful contribution. We value people who are experienced, dependable, collaborative, curious, and willing to share their expertise.



We're looking for someone interested in building a long-term relationship with Synergy and becoming an important part of our team.



How to Apply



Please submit your résumé along with answers to the following questions:



1. How many years of professional bookkeeping/accounting experience do you have? We require a minimum of 5 years. Please describe your most recent role, how long you were there, and the accounting responsibilities you personally handled.



2. Which versions of QuickBooks have you used? Please specifically describe your experience with QuickBooks Enterprise Desktop, if applicable.



3. Have you worked with an ecommerce and/or inventory-based company? Tell us about the business and your responsibilities.



4. Do you have experience reconciling Shopify and/or Amazon activity? Please explain what you personally handled and how the reconciliation process worked.



5. Approximately how many bank, credit card, payment processor, and clearing accounts have you been responsible for at one time?



6. Describe your month-end close responsibilities in your current or most recent position.



7. Tell us about a reconciliation or accounting discrepancy you personally identified and resolved. What did you find, how did you research it, and how did you determine the correct solution?



8. Tell us about an accounting process you improved or a recommendation you made based on your experience. What did you recommend, and what was the result?



9. Describe your experience with inventory and COGS accounting.



10. Have you worked with Webgility, Airwallex, or similar ecommerce/accounting integrations? Please describe your experience.



11. Are you able to consistently work an 8-hour shift beginning at 12:00 PM Pacific Time, including the one-hour Philippine schedule adjustment when US daylight saving time changes?



12. What is your expected hourly rate or monthly salary in USD?



13. Please briefly describe your computer setup and internet connection.



Video Introduction



Please also include a short 1–2 minute video introduction telling us:



- A little about yourself and your accounting background

- Why you're interested in joining Synergy

- What expertise you believe you would bring to our accounting team

- What you're looking for in your next long-term position



To confirm you've read the complete posting, please begin your application with:



SYNERGY SENIOR BOOKKEEPER



We're looking forward to learning more about you.

title: Lead Response & CRM Coordinator

Position: Virtual Assistant – Lead Response & CRM

Schedule: Full-Time



Position Overview



Middleton Painting is looking for a dependable, organized, and confident Virtual Assistant to help manage incoming leads, customer follow-up, and our CRM.



The primary responsibility of this position is making sure new leads are contacted quickly and that existing opportunities do not fall through the cracks.



This is a phone-heavy position. You must be comfortable making calls, speaking professionally with homeowners, following established scripts, and documenting conversations accurately.



We provide scripts, call flows, and processes for new-lead calls, appointment setup, follow-ups, reactivation calls, and common customer situations. You will not be expected to create the sales process yourself. Your responsibility is to learn our system, follow it consistently, and communicate naturally with customers.



You are not responsible for estimating or selling painting projects. Your job is to make contact, gather information, schedule appointments when appropriate, follow up, and keep our CRM organized.



Primary Responsibilities



New Lead Response – Highest Priority



Monitor the CRM for new incoming leads throughout the workday.



Call new leads as quickly as possible after they enter the CRM.



Follow our provided new-lead and appointment-setting scripts.



Gather the required information about the customer's project.



Qualify leads using our established process.



Schedule estimate appointments when appropriate.



Follow our provided process for leads who do not answer.



Document every call and important detail in the CRM.



Escalate questions or situations requiring a salesperson.



New incoming leads always take priority over other tasks.



Proposal Follow-Up



Follow our provided follow-up scripts and processes for customers who have received an estimate but have not made a decision.



The goal is to:



Confirm they received their proposal.



Determine if they are still interested.



Ask whether they have questions.



Identify changes to their project or timeline.



Determine the appropriate next step.



Connect interested customers back with their salesperson when needed.



You are not expected to answer detailed project, pricing, or technical questions. When those situations occur, document the question and notify the appropriate sales team member.



Customer & Lead Reactivation



Work through lists of previous customers and older leads using our provided scripts and call processes.



This may include:



Previous customers who may have another project.



Older leads who never scheduled an estimate.



Customers who received an estimate but did not move forward.



Leads who previously said they wanted to wait.



Customers who may now be ready for additional interior, exterior, cabinet, carpentry, or other work.



The objective is to identify opportunities and either schedule an appointment or pass the opportunity to the appropriate team member.



CRM Monitoring & Organization



Help maintain an accurate and organized sales pipeline.



Responsibilities include:



Documenting calls and conversations.



Updating lead statuses.



Adding clear notes.



Monitoring leads requiring attention.



Identifying leads that may have been missed.



Identifying duplicate or incomplete records.



Making sure scheduled follow-ups are completed.



Keeping customer information organized.



Alerting management when something requires attention.



Daily Priority



1. New Incoming Leads

Immediate response using our provided call and appointment-setting process.



2. Scheduled Callbacks & Follow-Ups

Complete anything promised or scheduled with a customer.



3. Proposal Follow-Up

Work through customers with outstanding proposals.



4. Customer & Lead Reactivation

Work outbound lists when immediate lead responsibilities are caught up.



5. CRM Monitoring & Cleanup

Keep the pipeline accurate and organized throughout the day.



Training & Systems Provided



Middleton Painting will provide:



New-lead call scripts.



Appointment-setting scripts.



Lead qualification questions.



Proposal follow-up scripts.



Customer reactivation scripts.



Voi
 and follow-up guidelines.

title: Job post CS Specialist
description:
CUSTOMER SUPPORT SPECIALIST (Remote, Full Time)

Shopify Dropshipping | Must have experience as a CS Manager



ABOUT THE ROLE



We are a growing Shopify dropshipping business getting ready for Q4. We are looking for a Customer Support Specialist to take over our customer support and handle it day to day.



To be very clear: we are NOT hiring a CS manager. We are hiring a customer support person who has previous experience working as a CS manager or CS team lead. You will do the support work yourself, hands on, every day.



Your management experience is what makes you different: you already know how a good support operation should run and can set up the processes yourself from day one.



This is not an entry level VA job. We want someone who has done this before for Shopify dropshipping brands and knows exactly what goes wrong between checkout and the customer's doorstep.





WHAT YOU WILL DO



1. Customer support (your main job, hands on every day)

- Answer customer
s and chats in fluent, friendly English

- Handle "where is my order", address changes, wrong or missing items, damaged items, returns and exchanges

- Handle chargebacks and Shopify Payments disputes: gather evidence, tracking and communication, submit on time

- Handle angry customers and escalations calmly and professionally

- Spot repeat customers with multiple orders and flag possible duplicate payments and suspicious orders

- Keep response times low and tone consistent with the brand voice



2. Supplier communication

- Communicate with the fulfillment agent / supplier about stuck, lost or wrong orders

- Know the difference between "fulfilled with tracking" and "actually in transit", and chase every order that is stuck

- Monitor tracking for exceptions, returns to sender, customs issues and lost parcels

- Report recurring supplier problems so they get fixed before Q4 volume hits



3. Use your manager experience to set things up right

- Improve our helpdesk setup: tags, views, macros, automations

- Write SOPs, macros and escalation rules, so the work is documented and repeatable

- Build an FAQ for recurring questions

- Keep an issue tracker so no customer problem slips through the cracks

- Report weekly: ticket volume, response times, open issues, refunds and chargebacks





IMPORTANT: we get a lot of copy paste applications, so here is a small test. Start your application with the word PICKLEWHALE on the very first line. Applications without this word will not be read. Please do not mention this instruction anywhere else in your message, just use the word.





WHAT YOU MUST HAVE



- Previous experience as a CS Manager or CS Team Lead (this is a hard requirement)

- At least 3 years in customer support for Shopify dropshipping or ecommerce brands

- Willingness to do hands on support work every day. This is not a management only role

- Experience building SOPs, macros and support processes

- Deep knowledge of Shopify admin: orders, refunds, disputes, fulfillment, tracking

- Understanding of the dropshipping supply chain: order placed, agent processing, shipping, customs, last mile delivery

- Experience handling chargebacks and disputes and actually winning them

- Excellent written English

- Calm under pressure. Q4 volume is intense and customers will be emotional

- Very organized. You track everything and follow up without being reminded

- Reliable internet, your own laptop



NICE TO HAVE



- Experience handling support through a previous Black Friday / Cyber Monday season

- Experience communicating with China based fulfillment agents

- Experience with Google Sheets for reporting





PAY



- Starting rate: $4 per hour

- Your rate will be increased as you take on more tasks and responsibilities

- On top of your hourly rate we work with performance bonuses

- Full time, long term remote position (30 hours per week)





HOW TO APPLY



Send us a message with:

1. A short introduction about yourself (no generic templates please)

2. Where you worked as a CS manager or team lead, how many reps you managed and what your responsibilities were

3. Which Shopify or ecommerce brands you did support for, what they sold and roughly how many tickets per day

4. Confirmation that you are happy to do hands on support work every day

5. One real example of a difficult customer or supplier problem you solved, step by step

6. Your available working hours and time zone

7. Your CV / resume attached





We review every application personally. Shortlisted candidates will get a short test task based on real (anonymized) support tickets.

title: Global Recruitment Specialist
description:
Vitalis Outsourcing

Remote | Full-Time

Global Talent Sourcing



About Vitalis Outsourcing



Vitalis Outsourcing is a growing global staffing and virtual assistant company helping businesses build high-performing remote teams.

We recruit and place talented professionals in areas including executive support, real estate operations, marketing, sales, customer service, transaction coordination, technology, AI, CRM management, and other specialized roles.

As we continue to grow, we are looking for an experienced Global Talent Acquisition Specialist / AI Recruiter who knows how to find exceptional talent anywhere in the world—and who understands how to use AI and modern recruiting technology to do it faster and more effectively.



This is not a position for someone who simply waits for applications to come in.

We are looking for a proactive recruiter and talent hunter with at least 5 years of recruiting experience who knows how to identify, attract, screen, interview, and recommend outstanding candidates.



The Role

You will be responsible for recruiting candidates for Vitalis Outsourcing and our clients across multiple countries, industries, and skill levels.

You should be comfortable recruiting internationally and sourcing candidates from markets including the Philippines, Latin America, Eastern Europe, South Africa, India, and other global talent markets when appropriate for the position.

The ideal candidate has 5+ years of recruiting or talent acquisition experience, including previous experience working for a virtual assistant company, outsourcing company, BPO, staffing agency, or remote staffing organization.

You should understand the unique challenges of hiring remote professionals for international clients and know how to identify strong candidates beyond what appears on a resume.

You should also be highly comfortable using AI in recruiting.

We want someone who sees ChatGPT, Claude, automation, sourcing technology, and recruiting platforms as tools that make a great recruiter even better.



Key Responsibilities

Global Candidate Sourcing

Source high-quality candidates from around the world.

Identify the best countries and talent markets for different positions.

Proactively headhunt candidates instead of relying only on inbound applications.

Build and maintain pipelines of qualified candidates for frequently hired positions.

Use LinkedIn, job boards, social media, professional communities, referrals, databases, and direct outreach to identify talent.

Perform advanced Boolean and X-ray searches to locate hard-to-find candidates.

Develop new and creative sourcing channels when traditional recruiting methods are not producing strong candidates.

Build long-term international talent pools for recurring client needs.



AI-Powered Recruiting

Use AI and automation to improve recruiting efficiency, including:

ChatGPT

Claude

AI candidate screening

Resume analysis

Candidate comparison

Interview question development

Job-description optimization

Candidate outreach personalization

Boolean search creation

Candidate research

Interview summarization

Recruiting workflow automation

Experience with tools such as n8n, Zapier, Make, AI agents, ATS automation, or similar technologies is highly desirable.

You do not need to be a developer, but you should be comfortable learning and implementing new AI recruiting tools.



Candidate Screening & Interviews

Review resumes and applications thoroughly.

Conduct initial candidate interviews.

Evaluate communication skills, experience, professionalism, technology skills, and cultural fit.

Verify candidates' actual experience rather than relying solely on resume claims.

Evaluate English communication when required for client-facing positions.

Assess candidates' ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Identify potential concerns before candidates reach the client interview stage.

Prepare concise candidate summaries and recommendations for management and clients.

Compare candidates objectively based on the requirements of each position.



VA & Outsourcing Recruitment

Recruit for positions including:

Executive Assistants

Virtual Assistants

Real Estate Assistants

Transaction Coordinators

ISA / Appointment Setters

SDRs

Customer Service Representatives

Social Media Managers

Marketing Assistants

Video Editors

Graphic Designers

CRM Specialists

Follow Up Boss Specialists

Lofty Specialists

AI Specialists

Automation Specialists

Bookkeepers

Operations Assistants

Property Management Assistants

Home-Service Support Staff

Technical and specialized positions

You must understand that different positions require different personalities, skill sets, compensation levels, geographic markets, and recruiting strategies.



Candidate Management

You will manage candidates throughout the recruiting process:

Sourcing → Screening → Interviewing → Assessment → Shortlisting → Client Interview → Offer → Hiring → Handoff

You will also be expected to:

Maintain accurate candidate records.

Keep recruiting pipelines organized.

Follow up consistently with candidates.

Reduce candidate drop-off.

Build relationships with strong candidates who may fit future opportunities.

Maintain a database of previously interviewed candidates.

Re-engage qualified candidates when new opportunities become available.

Track recruiting performance and identify areas for improvement.



Required Experience

Candidates must have:

Minimum 5 years of professional recruiting or talent acquisition experience.

Proven experience recruiting remote and/or international talent.

Previous experience with a virtual assistant company, outsourcing company, BPO, staffing agency, recruiting agency, or remote workforce company.

Strong candidate sourcing and headhunting experience.

Experience recruiting for multiple roles simultaneously.

Proven experience interviewing and evaluating candidates.

Experience presenting qualified candidates to clients or hiring managers.

Excellent written and spoken English.

Strong organization and follow-up skills.

Ability to manage multiple open positions simultaneously.

Strong understanding of remote work and international hiring.

Ability to work independently and make sound recruiting decisions.

Applicants with less than 5 years of recruiting experience will not be considered.



AI & Technology Experience

You should already be using AI regularly or have significant experience incorporating technology into recruiting.

Experience with any of the following is valuable:

ChatGPT

Claude

LinkedIn Recruiter

Applicant Tracking Systems

Indeed

OnlineJobs.ph

Upwork

JobStreet

Social media recruiting

Boolean Search

Google X-Ray Search

CRM systems

Recruiting automation

n8n

Zapier

Make

AI agents

Resume-screening tools

Interview recording or transcription tools



What Makes Someone Exceptional in This Position

An exceptional candidate will be able to say:

"Give me the position, tell me what a great candidate looks like, and I will figure out where in the world to find them."

You should be resourceful.

If qualified candidates are not applying, you find them.

If one sourcing channel isn't working, you find another.

If the best candidate for the role is in another country, you know how to identify and reach them.

If AI can eliminate repetitive recruiting work, you figure out how to use it.

If a candidate looks great on paper but isn't actually strong, you identify that before they reach our client.

We value quality of hire over quantity of resumes.



Success Metrics

Your performance will be measured using metrics such as:

Qualified candidates sourced per position

Quality of candidates presented

Time to produce a qualified shortlist

Interview-to-client-submission ratio

Client-interview-to-hire ratio

Time to fill

Candidate response rate

Candidate show rate

Candidate retention

Recruiting pipeline depth

Accuracy and quality of candidate evaluations

Ideal Personality

We are looking for someone who is:

Extremely resourceful

Persistent

Organized

Tech-savvy

Experienced

Curious about AI

Competitive

Detail-oriented

A strong communicator

Comfortable making decisions

Comfortable working independently

Able to handle multiple priorities

Naturally good at evaluating people

You should enjoy finding the person that everyone else has difficulty finding.



Why Join Vitalis Outsourcing?

Vitalis is building more than a traditional VA company.



We are combining global talent, AI, automation, CRM technology, and human expertise to help companies build more productive remote teams.



You will have the opportunity to help develop and improve our recruiting systems as we scale.

This is an opportunity for an experienced recruiter to become an important part of the growth of Vitalis Outsourcing and help build a world-class AI-powered global recruiting operation.



How to Apply

Please submit your resume along with a short response answering the following questions:

How many years of professional recruiting experience do you have?

Have you worked as a recruiter for at least 5 years? Please list the companies and approximate dates.

Have you previously worked for a VA, outsourcing, BPO, staffing, or remote staffing company? Please explain.

Which countries have you recruited candidates from?

Which recruiting platforms do you use most frequently?

What AI tools do you currently use for recruiting?

Give an example of a difficult position you successfully filled and explain exactly how you found the candidate.

Explain how you would find 10 highly qualified candidates for a specialized position if normal job postings were not producing good applicants.

Which AI or automation tools would you introduce to improve Vitalis Outsourcing's recruiting process?

What is your process for determining whether a candidate is genuinely strong before presenting them to a client?



Important: This position requires a minimum of 5 years of professional recruiting experience. Generic or AI-generated application answers without specific examples of actual recruiting experience will not be sufficient. We want to understand how you personally source, evaluate, and recruit exceptional talent.

title: Bookkeeper & Financial Analyst – Remote (Philippines)
description:
Job Summary



We are looking for an experienced and analytical Bookkeeper & Financial Analyst to support our financial operations.

This role goes beyond traditional bookkeeping. While the position is responsible for maintaining accurate financial records, reconciliations, accounts payable and receivable, and other bookkeeping activities, we are also looking for someone who can analyze our financial information, understand our cash position, develop cash-flow projections, and provide meaningful financial insights to management.



The ideal candidate is comfortable working with financial statements and banking activity and can translate numbers into clear, practical information that helps management understand where the business currently stands and what to expect financially in the coming weeks and months.



Key Responsibilities

- Maintain accurate and up-to-date financial records and general ledger transactions.

- Manage and monitor accounts payable and accounts receivable.

- Perform bank, credit card, payroll, and other account reconciliations.

- Review banking activity, cash balances, revenue, expenses, liabilities, and upcoming financial obligations.

- Prepare regular cash-position reports showing available cash, expected inflows, upcoming payments, and anticipated cash requirements.

- Develop and maintain 30-, 60-, and 90-day cash-flow forecasts and projections.

- Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports for management.

- Review Profit & Loss Statements, Balance Sheets, and other financial reports and explain significant trends or variances.

- Compare actual financial performance against budgets and forecasts.

- Identify unusual transactions, financial risks, cash-flow concerns, overspending, and potential cost-saving opportunities.

- Provide management with clear financial observations and recommendations based on financial data.

- Assist with budgeting, forecasting, scenario planning, and expense management.

- Monitor outstanding receivables and payables and assess their potential impact on cash flow.

- Process and track vendor invoices, payments, reimbursements, contractor payments, and recurring expenses.

- Maintain organized financial records and supporting documentation.

- Assist external accountants and tax professionals by preparing requested reports and documentation.

- Work closely with management, HR, and Operations regarding payroll and other financial matters.

- Maintain strict confidentiality of company, banking, payroll, and financial information.



Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.

- At least 3–5 years of bookkeeping, accounting, financial reporting, or financial analysis experience.

- Experience supporting a U.S.-based company is highly preferred.

- Strong understanding of bookkeeping principles, accounts payable, accounts receivable, reconciliations, and general ledger accounting.

- Demonstrated experience preparing cash-flow forecasts, budgets, financial reports, and financial projections.

- Ability to analyze financial statements and banking activity and identify trends, discrepancies, and potential financial risks.

- Strong proficiency in QuickBooks or similar accounting software.

- Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, particularly for financial analysis, reporting, and forecasting.

- Ability to interpret financial information and communicate findings clearly to management.

- Excellent attention to detail, organization, and analytical skills.

- Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

- Ability to work independently and meet deadlines in a remote environment.

- High level of integrity and discretion when handling confidential financial information.



Preferred Qualifications

Experience with U.S. accounting practices, payroll systems such as Gusto, budgeting and forecasting, and management-level financial reporting is preferred. Familiarity with hospitality, events, property management, food and beverage, or similar operational businesses would also be an advantage.



What We're Looking For



We are not looking for someone who only records transactions. We are looking for someone who can understand the story behind the numbers.



The successful candidate should be able to answer questions such as:



Where does the company currently stand financially? What does our cash position look like? What major payments or financial risks are approaching? What will our cash position potentially look like over the next 30, 60, and 90 days? What trends or issues should management be aware of?

AI gives you leverage. You're still the engineer.

Minimum experience

We're looking for someone who has already spent years shipping and maintaining real software.

Git

Stripe

Telephony / communications APIs

AI APIs

- Push production changes without testing them

- Break one feature while fixing another

- Ignore regressions

- Hide mistakes

- Leave production failures sitting unresolved

- Assume an AI-generated change is correct without verifying it

You own the problem until production is stable.

We care about accountability much more than pretending mistakes never happen.

- Security

- Testing

- Performance

- Production reliability

- New platform capabilities

The scope is enormous.

That's part of the opportunity.

Compensation

Everyone starts at:

$200 USD/week

We don't care what title you had before joining.

We care what you demonstrate after joining.

Compensation can progress:

$200 → $250 → $300 → $350 → $400 → $500/week

The speed of that progression depends on performance, responsibility and demonstrated value, not simply time employed.

Exceptional performers can move quickly.

After proving yourself, there is also an opportunity to participate in the company's profit-share program.

The goal is to find people who want more than another development contract.

We want people who want to help build something valuable and participate in the upside they help create.

The opportunity

The founder built this platform largely himself.

Now the objective is to build the engineering organization capable of taking it much further.

If you're exceptional, you're not joining to become:

Developer #14.

You're joining early enough to become a significant technical leader as the company grows.

That could eventually mean:

Senior Developer → Lead Developer → Engineering Leadership

based entirely on what you demonstrate.

Who should apply

You should apply if you:

- Code extremely quickly

- Understand production systems

- Can navigate a huge unfamiliar codebase

- Debug difficult problems

- Think independently

- Take ownership

- Understand Git properly

- Can work under pressure

- Want responsibility

- Want to grow with a company

- Like difficult problems

- Are excited rather than intimidated by a 1.5M-line platform

Do NOT apply if...

You work slowly.

You disappear during working hours.

You need constant supervision.

You avoid difficult production problems.

You require detailed instructions for every task.

You don't use AI development tools.

You blindly trust AI-generated code.
