title: Administrator, Operations — Full Loop CRM - Operations Manager in Training
description:
Full Loop CRM is looking for someone to **help operate and grow the company around the technology.**



This is not a developer position.



This is not a traditional virtual assistant position.



And this is not a job where you wait every morning for someone to send you a list of tasks.



You will start as an **Administrator, Operations**, learn Full Loop from the inside, and be trained with the intention of developing into an **Operations Manager responsible for the non-technical operation of Full Loop CRM.**



## What is Full Loop?



Full Loop is an end-to-end operating system built for service businesses.



It connects:



**Leads → communications → customers → sales → booking → scheduling → dispatch → workers → payments → payouts → reviews → retention → finance → HR → reporting.**



The platform is already built and operating real businesses.



Now we're building the **company around the platform.**



That's where you come in.



# Your mission



### Learn Full Loop better than anyone except the people who built it.



Then help us operate it, improve it, support its customers and grow it.



Initially, you'll work directly with the founder and learn every part of the platform.



As you prove yourself, you'll take ownership of more and more of Full Loop's daily non-technical operation.



The long-term goal is for you to become someone the founder can say:



> **“Handle Full Loop operations.”**



And know that it's handled.



# What you'll actually do



## Customer & Tenant Operations



You'll help manage Full Loop customers from onboarding through daily use.



That includes:



- New-customer onboarding

- Tenant setup

- Account activation

- Customer communication

- Training customers on Full Loop

- Answering questions

- Helping customers understand features

- Monitoring account health

- Identifying customers who aren't properly using the platform

- Following up

- Solving operational problems

- Escalating genuine technical issues to development

- Helping customers get measurable value from the system



Your job isn't simply to answer support tickets.



### Your job is to make Full Loop customers successful.



## Know the platform



You should eventually understand:



- CRM

- CommHub

- Voice

- SMS

-

- Booking

- Scheduling

- Dispatch

- Customer records

- Worker portals

- Payments

- Payouts

- Reviews

- SEO

- AI

- Yinez

- Zeus

- Finance

- HR

- Recruiting

- Reporting

- Tenant onboarding

- Business operations



You don't need to code these systems.



But you need to know how they're supposed to work.



# Work directly with development



You'll become an important bridge between:



### CUSTOMER → OPERATIONS → FOUNDER → DEVELOPMENT



When something breaks, don't tell the developer:



> “Customer says it's broken.”



Find out:



**What happened?  

Who experienced it?  

What were they doing?  

Can you reproduce it?  

When did it begin?  

What should have happened?  

What actually happened?  

How important is it?**



Then give development something useful.



After it's fixed:



### Test it yourself.



Don't assume “deployed” means “solved.”



# Quality control



You will continuously use Full Loop as a real operator.



That means:



- Test workflows

- Find friction

- Identify confusing UX

- Find bugs

- Check customer accounts

- Monitor automation

- Verify releases

- Document problems

- Organize feature requests

- Prioritize issues

- Follow problems through resolution



We want someone who notices things **before customers complain about them.**



# Help direct product improvement



You'll talk to customers.



That gives you information developers don't have.



Your responsibility is to organize that information intelligently.



Not:



> “Someone wants this feature.”



Instead:



> “Five customers asked for essentially the same thing this week. Here's why they need it, here's the workflow they're trying to accomplish, and here's what I think would solve it.”



That's useful product operations.



# Help grow Full Loop



This is not only customer support.



You'll also help with:



- New customer inquiries

- Lead follow-up

- Demo coordination

- Customer onboarding

- Sales administration

- Customer retention

- Account expansion

- Partnerships

- Case studies

- Testimonials

- Customer feedback

- Internal documentation

- Marketing coordination

- Launches

- Operational projects



As Full Loop grows, you'll help build the operating team underneath it.



# Speed matters



We operate quickly.



If a customer has a problem, they should not wait hours because you're “working on it.”



If something breaks across multiple tenants, that's not tomorrow's problem.



If a developer says something is fixed, verify it.



If a new customer is ready to onboard, move.



If you don't understand something, ask.



### Do not sit on problems.



We value **speed + accuracy + ownership.**



# You need confidence



You'll be working directly with:



- The founder

- Developers

- Business owners

- Customers

- Administrators

- Operators



You need to be capable of communicating clearly and confidently.



If something is wrong, say so.



If you disagree, explain why.



If you made a mistake, own it and fix it.



If someone hasn't completed something, follow up.



We don't need someone who says:



> “Sorry boss.”



We need someone who says:



> **“I found the problem. Here's what happened. Here's what I'm doing about it.”**



# Operations Manager in Training



The title matters.



We're not looking for someone to remain an administrator forever.



The path is:



### Administrator → Senior Administrator → Operations Manager



As Operations Manager, you could eventually oversee:



- Full Loop administrators

- Customer success

- Customer onboarding

- Support

- Tenant operations

- Sales administration

- QA

- Product operations

- Internal processes

- Hiring/training

- Performance

- Daily non-technical operations



The founder should increasingly focus on **product, strategy and growth**, while you build the ability to run the operation around Full Loop.



# Compensation



Everyone starts at:



### **$200 USD/week**



The first stage is about proving yourself.



We don't care what somebody else paid you previously.



We care about what you demonstrate here.



Compensation can progress:



### **$200 → $250 → $300 → $350 → $400 → $500/week**



Progression is based on:



**Performance. Responsibility. Speed. Reliability. Results.**



Not simply time employed.



Exceptional performers can advance quickly.



After proving yourself, there is also an opportunity to participate in Full Loop's **profit-share program**.



The objective is to create substantial upside for people who become genuinely important to the company.



# Who we're looking for



You should be:



- Extremely fast

- Highly responsive

- Intelligent

- Organized

- Confident

- Aggressive about getting results

- Excellent in English

- Comfortable speaking with U.S. business owners

- Technologically capable

- Comfortable learning complex software

- Good under pressure

- Able to prioritize

- Able to make decisions

- Able to manage multiple responsibilities

- Comfortable holding other people accountable

- Comfortable working with developers

- Customer-focused

- Sales-minded

- Curious

- Reliable

- Hungry to advance

- Looking for something long-term



Experience with SaaS, CRMs, customer success, operations, sales, project management, support, startups or service businesses is valuable.



But **speed, judgment, ownership and drive matter more.**



# Do NOT apply if...



You disappear during working hours.



You need repeated reminders.



You avoid difficult conversations.



You are uncomfortable talking to customers.



You move slowly when something is urgent.



You need detailed instructions for every decision.



You blame other people when something goes wrong.



You tell us something is fixed without checking it.



You wait for customers to report problems instead of monitoring the platform.



You want an easy remote administrative job.



### This is not that job.



# Your application is your video



Forget the résumé.



I don't want a generic cover letter.



I don't want an AI-written application explaining that you're “detail-oriented and hardworking.”



### Send me a 2–5 minute video.



Tell me:



- Who are you?

- Why should I hire you?

- What have you operated or managed before?

- How quickly do you learn complicated software?

- How do you handle pressure?

- How do you deal with an unhappy customer?

- How would you work with developers?

- What would you do if a customer reported that a major Full Loop feature stopped working?

- What would you do if a developer said it was fixed but the customer said it still wasn't working?

- How would you organize feedback from 20 different customers?

- Why do you want responsibility instead of simply completing assigned tasks?

- Where do you want to be professionally in two years?



And answer this:



# “If I gave you Full Loop operations tomorrow, what would you do during your first 30 days?”



## Send your video directly to Jeff on WhatsApp



### **+1 (212)
**



Send:



**Your name + “Full Loop Operations” + your video.**



No résumé required.



No cover letter required.



We're looking for someone who watches this opportunity and thinks:



# “Give me the platform. I'll learn it, own it and help grow it.”

title: Media Buyer Specialist (PH)
description:
!!! PLEASE READ THE ENTIRE JOB POST BEFORE APPLYING !!!



PH - Media Buyer Specialist



We're looking for a Media Buyer Specialist to own the performance and impact of a large book of complex, custom paid media campaigns for our practices — leading strategy, setup, optimization, and communication with practices and cross-functional teams to get results.



You'll also be stepping into using AI as leverage — scaling both the quality and volume of your work by recognizing patterns, making good bets, and playing to exploit every advantage, rather than relying on automated platforms or SOPs to do the thinking for you.



Ad buying is changing fast. This role exists for someone who understands data, tracking, and the full funnel deeply enough to know when to follow our best practices and when to trust their own judgment — and who's ready to own the outcome either way. Getting this right lets the rest of our media team focus on their own work instead of constantly course-correcting an underperforming book.



Our objectives for the role

- Own the performance of a large, complex book of campaigns, around 50 initially and scales up with time — from strategy and setup through optimization — and be accountable for the outcome, whether you followed our playbooks or your own judgment to get there.

- Build deep command of our reporting and tracking systems so you can pull your own data, diagnose account health quickly and accurately, and manage risk proactively before it shows up in results.

- Use AI as leverage to run more accounts at a higher level — treating media buying as a competitive game of pattern recognition, hypothesis-driven testing, and educated bets – to drive results you’ll own.

- Contribute best practices and workflows — like a new setup approach or AI-assisted process — that get adopted as standard team practice.

- Use your understanding of the full funnel we deploy and your excellent communication skills to influence clients and cross-functional teams towards better performance for the campaigns you own.



We're looking for:

- Ownership and accountability — you take full responsibility for a large book of accounts' results, regardless of whether you followed an SOP or your own judgment to get there.

- Autonomy and judgment — you know when to lean on established playbooks and when to deviate, and you're comfortable making that call independently.

- Optimization and testing rigor — you approach media buying like a competitive game: pattern recognition, hypothesis-driven tests, and educated bets, not guesswork.

- Tracking and reporting command — you can pull your own data and diagnose account and tracking health quickly, without waiting on someone else to hand you a report.

- Productive use of AI — you use AI to scale the volume and quality of your work, but you don't let it replace your own judgment on what actually moves the needle.



Why Join us?

- Above all, we're in this to empower small business owners to own and grow their businesses. If you succeed, MedSpas will remain the opportunity for independent owner-operators instead of being dominated by a small number of large chains. If that speaks to you, speak to us.

- This is a role built for media buyers who want to own outcomes, not just execute tickets — full autonomy over a book of accounts, real say in when to follow SOPs versus your own judgment, and credit for the results either way.

- It's an IC track with real influence: your work shapes team playbooks and best practices, without requiring you to manage people to get that influence.

- You'll work within a high-caliber team where iron sharpens iron — challenging, fast-paced, and genuinely fun if you like this game.

- Competitive salary

title: Paid Media Creative Specialist (PH)
description:
!!! READ ENTIRE JOB POST BEFORE APPLYING !!!



PH - Paid Media Creative Specialist



We're looking for a PH - Marketing Creative Specialist to own the creative outcomes for paid social campaigns — concepts, iterations, and final static and video deliverables — directly driving the metrics (CTR, hook rate, thumb-stop/hold rate, cost per result) that determine campaign performance, while also making ads that are beautiful and delight our clients.



You'll also be stepping into building and owning AI-augmented creative workflows — using AI as leverage to increase the volume and quality of what you ship, without letting it replace your own trend instincts and creative judgment.



We’re looking for a creative who loves Meta - who lives and breathes Instagram. And who is obsessed with what makes content convert - both organically and in paid ads. You’ll get the autonomy and creative freedom to make amazing designs - and the responsibility for how those perform, and more importantly, using how they perform to improve what we make next. Done well, you’ll help us build creative capability that not just delights our clients, but delivers on ROI and growth.



Our objectives for the role

- Ship creatives that delight our practices: creatives that highlight what’s best about their practices, results, and branding – and that they’re so excited about that they regularly ask us if they can post our ads as organic content on their feeds, too.

- Own creative performance (CTR, hook rate, thumb-stop/hold rate, cost per result) across your designs – and turn patterns of performance into meaningful insights and repeatable elements or frameworks that get actioned in feedback loops into your work and the broader team.

- Spot trends and micro-trends and translate them into on-brand, executable static and video creatives – that appeal to the right audiences and pain points for a given campaign.

- Demonstrate command of production tools, specs, file setup, and platform requirements across Meta placements, and become a go-to resource on specs and complex production issues (compression, accessibility, delivery).

- Contribute to AI-driven creative workflows and frameworks — for concepting, production, or testing — that get adopted across the broader creative team.

- Scale a creative process or workflow into standard team practice, and act as a subject-matter expert whose creative-performance patterns guide the rest of the team.



We're looking for:

- Top Tier Aesthetic Taste — you know the exact layouts, fonts, music, and styling that will make creative pop. You can design for multiple aesthetics and never ship a boring or basic creative.

- Creative ownership and execution — you can spot a trend, shape the concept, write the direction, and personally ship the work across both static and video, within provided frameworks, not just execute someone else's brief. This includes writing the copy and executing the design work, on-brand, and owning its performance in the ad platforms.

- Performance fluency — you're fluent in performance creative and think in terms of the metrics that matter: CTR, hook rate, cost per result, and ultimately, ROI.

- Turn Patterns into Systems — you see the hook that performs in every video ad you ship as a repeatable element you should mix into every new video we script, and that one red button that always makes a graphic’s cost per lead lower as your ace in your back pocket for accounts whose creative just doesn’t hit. And you’re ready to take this skill further into templates that de-risk creative performance, using insights from across a portfolio of brands running similar ads.

- Production mastery — deep command of specs, file setup,editing/creating tools (including AI augmentation), and platform requirements, with the ability to independently resolve production issues that stump others.

- Trend fluency — you already think like a trend-setter; spotting what's next is a skill you own, not something you outsource to an algorithm.

- Productive use of AI — you build and own AI-augmented workflows, using AI as leverage rather than a crutch or a replacement for your judgment. Ads and creatives that are obviously AI give you the ick - and you would never give us a final product that looks like Claude, or Chat, or some other AI tool’s basic output - even though you probably did use them to help you execute it.

title: Revenue Cycle Manager
description:
Virtual RCM Manager – Behavioral Health Billing

Nurowav TMS & Psychiatry



Position: Virtual Assistant / Revenue Cycle Management Manager

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Independent Contractor / Virtual Assistant

Schedule: Part-Time or Full-Time, depending on experience and availability



About Nurowav



Nurowav is a growing behavioral health practice providing psychiatric services, TMS, Spravato, medication management, and other behavioral health services across multiple locations.



We are seeking an experienced Virtual RCM Manager who understands the complete behavioral health revenue cycle and can independently manage, monitor, and improve our billing operations.



This is a hands-on position. We are not looking for someone who only submits claims. The ideal candidate understands what happens from the time a patient is scheduled and insurance is verified through claim submission, payment posting, denials, A/R follow-up, appeals, patient balances, and final collection.



Behavioral Health Billing Experience Is REQUIRED



Applicants must have prior experience with behavioral health/mental health billing.



Experience with general medical billing alone is not sufficient. Experience with psychiatric practices, TMS, Spravato, psychotherapy, medication management, and/or other behavioral health services is highly preferred.



Key Responsibilities



The RCM Manager will be responsible for overseeing and actively working all aspects of the Nurowav revenue cycle, including:



Insurance & Front-End RCM

Review and oversee insurance verification processes

Understand behavioral health benefits and patient responsibility

Identify authorization and eligibility issues before they become billing problems

Monitor prior authorization requirements

Ensure services are billed according to payer requirements

Identify front-end issues contributing to denials and delayed payments

Claims Management

Oversee and/or perform electronic and paper claim submission

Review claims for accuracy prior to submission

Understand CPT, HCPCS, ICD-10, modifiers, units, POS, and payer-specific requirements

Monitor claim acceptance and rejection reports

Correct and resubmit rejected claims

Track outstanding claims and filing deadlines

Identify recurring billing errors and implement corrective procedures

Payment Posting

Oversee accurate posting of ERAs, EOBs, insurance payments, patient payments, adjustments, and denials

Ensure payments are posted timely and accurately

Reconcile payments against deposits and remittance reports

Identify unapplied payments and credits

Monitor outstanding payment-posting work

Accounts Receivable Management

Manage the practice's entire A/R process

Work aging reports by payer, patient, and date of service

Identify high-dollar and aging accounts requiring immediate attention

Follow up on unpaid claims

Contact insurance companies regarding claim status

Identify underpayments and incorrect payer processing

Work denials and determine appropriate next steps

Submit corrected claims and appeals

Establish an organized follow-up schedule

Reduce aging A/R and improve overall collections

Denials & Appeals

Identify denial trends

Research payer-specific denial reasons

Determine whether claims require correction, reconsideration, or appeal

Prepare and submit appeals

Track appeals through resolution

Maintain documentation of denial activity

Identify systemic issues causing repeat denials

Patient Accounts

Review patient balances

Understand deductibles, copays, coinsurance, and patient responsibility

Identify incorrect patient balances

Assist with patient billing questions

Monitor outstanding patient balances

Coordinate appropriate collection workflows

Revenue Cycle Reporting



The RCM Manager will be responsible for producing and/or reviewing regular reports including:



A/R aging

Insurance A/R

Patient A/R

Claims submitted

Claims rejected

Claims denied

Payments posted

Unapplied payments

Outstanding claims

High-dollar A/R

A/R by payer

Aging by payer

Denial trends

Collection activity

Monthly revenue cycle performance

RCM Team Management



The RCM Manager will work alongside other virtual billing assistants and will be responsible for helping ensure that work is:



Assigned appropriately

Completed timely

Accurately documented

Followed through to resolution

Properly communicated between team members



You will be expected to identify when work is falling behind and take initiative to correct it rather than waiting to be instructed.



What We Are Looking For



The ideal candidate is:



Experienced in behavioral health billing

Highly knowledgeable about the complete revenue cycle

Comfortable working independently

Extremely organized and detail-oriented

Strong with A/R management

Experienced with insurance follow-up

Comfortable working denials and appeals

Able to identify billing errors and determine how to correct them

Comfortable managing other virtual billing staff

Able to analyze reports and identify problems

A strong communicator

Reliable and responsive

Comfortable working in a fast-growing practice

Able to take ownership of the billing process from beginning to end

You Must Be Able To Answer Questions Such As:

Why is a claim unpaid?

Was the claim actually received by the payer?

Is the claim rejected or denied?

What caused the denial?

Does the claim need to be corrected or appealed?

Is the patient's balance accurate?

Was the insurance payment posted correctly?

Was the claim paid according to the contracted allowable?

Is there an authorization issue?

Is the claim approaching timely filing?

What is causing our A/R to increase?

What steps need to be taken to get the account resolved?



We are looking for someone who can investigate the answer—not someone who simply reports that there is a problem.



Preferred Experience



Strong preference will be given to candidates with experience in:



Psychiatry

Behavioral health

TMS

Spravato/esketamine

Medication management

Psychotherapy

Commercial insurance

Medicare

Medicaid

Prior authorizations

ERA/EOB processing

Denials and appeals

High-volume A/R management

Multi-location practices



Experience with Ritten or similar behavioral health billing/EMR platforms is a plus.



Position Expectations



This is an important role within our organization. The RCM Manager will have significant responsibility for ensuring that services provided by Nurowav are properly billed, collected, posted, reconciled, and followed through to resolution.



The successful candidate must be comfortable working independently while collaborating closely with a team of virtual assistants and Nurowav management.



We need someone who will take ownership of the revenue cycle, recognize problems before they become larger issues, and continuously look for ways to improve our billing and collections process.



Minimum Requirements

Prior behavioral health billing experience – REQUIRED

Demonstrated RCM experience

Strong A/R experience

Strong understanding of insurance claims

Experience with denials and appeals

Excellent attention to detail

Strong computer and organizational skills

Ability to work independently

Reliable internet and professional remote-work environment

Excellent written and verbal communication

Compensation



Compensation will be based on experience, behavioral health billing expertise, and level of RCM management experience.



To Apply:

Please submit your resume and include a brief description of your behavioral health billing experience, including the types of services you have billed, insurance payers you have worked with, billing/EMR systems you have used, and your experience managing A/R and denials.



Applicants without behavioral health billing experience will not be considered.

title: Senior Video Editor
description:
You Get One Shot. Don't Waste It on Another 7-Second Clip.



Video Editor — Cinematic Long-Form + Short-Form Commercial Tulen Agency · Remote · Paid test edit → ongoing role



You get one shot to make something people will remember for the rest of their lives.



Will you waste it?



Hi, I'm Yewan. Yes, the one writing this job post at 2 a.m. We're looking for someone great. Dare I say, really f*cking amazing at video editing.



We want to make the kind of videos people remember for years. The kind that quietly reset what people think is possible with a camera and a timeline.



But enough about us. Let's talk about you.







WHERE YOU PROBABLY ARE RIGHT NOW.



You're an artist. A storyteller. You can feel when a shot has held one frame too long.



And you're spending your days cutting 30-second clips for a faceless channel, or stitching AI footage together that people will forget before they finish scrolling past it.



Maybe you're freelancing, and every brief says "make it pop" and nothing else. Maybe you're at an agency where editing is the last step in an assembly line, so you get the footage late, the notes vague, and the deadline yesterday. Maybe the best thing you ever cut sits in a private Drive folder because the client went with the version their nephew liked.



You know how to do this at a much higher level. Nobody has asked you to.



If that landed, keep reading. If it didn't, this isn't your role, and we'd rather you know now.



WHAT WE'RE ACTUALY MAKING

Tulen runs marketing for wedding venues, event spaces, restaurants, and hospitality brands across the US. Places where people have the best nights of their lives.



That's the whole brief, really. Our clients sell moments. Most of the video made about them looks like everyone else's.



We're building two things, and you'd own both:



- Cinematic long-form. Luxury vlog storytelling, brand films, interviews, and podcast episodes, typically 3–15 minutes. Real narrative arcs. Pacing that breathes. Color that has a point of view. The kind of piece someone watches to the end and then sends to a friend.

- Short-form commercial. 15–60 second vertical ads and social cuts for Reels, TikTok, and Shorts. Same taste, compressed. Multiple hooks off the same footage, built to perform, not just to look good.



Most editors are good at one of these. We're looking for the one who can switch between them in the same afternoon.



This isn't a "YouTube editor" role. It's closer to a cinematographer's editor and post-production lead: someone whose taste becomes Tulen's standard.



WHAT YOU'D ACTUALLY BE DOING

- Turning raw vlog, venue, podcast, and interview footage into cinematic pieces with real story structure

- Cutting direct response ads and feed-native short-form, with multiple hook variations for testing

- Color correction and grading with an actual look, not a LUT and a prayer

- Clean dialogue, music mixing, sound design

- Titles, lower-thirds, captions, and motion graphics where they earn their place

- Pushing back on the brief when you see a better story in the footage

- Helping build Tulen's video workflows, standards, and eventually the team around them



WHO THIS IS FOR

- Taste first. Shot selection, story instincts, rhythm. We can't teach this, so it's the first thing we look for.

- 3–5+ years editing professionally, across both long-form and short-form.

- Advanced in Premiere Pro (DaVinci for color is a strong plus).

- Color and sound are part of the edit to you, not an afterthought.

- You know current Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube specs and why vertical pacing is different.

- Organized. Clean project files, version control, sane naming. We work out of Google Drive, ClickUp, and Slack.

- You communicate early. A blocker flagged on Monday is a non-issue. Flagged on Friday, it's a problem.

- Bonus: wedding, hospitality, travel, or luxury brand work; direct response ad experience; commercial or film production background; motion graphics; captioning workflows.



WHAT WE DON'T CARE ABOUT

Your résumé, mostly. A flashy showreel, even less. Reels are the best 40 seconds of someone's career set to a drop.



We care how you think. Why you cut where you cut. What you left out.



HOW THIS WORKS

Step one is a paid test edit. Real footage, paid, five working days.



You get a raw podcast recording and b-roll across six environments. No script, no reference cut, no shot list. That's on purpose. We're not testing whether you can execute someone else's idea. We're testing your judgment.



Two cuts from the same footage:

1. A 30–45 second direct response ad, voiceover-driven. You build the VO from what the speaker actually said. You're selecting, not scripting: find the argument and cut the rest. Voice leads, picture follows.

2. A 15-second cut built for the feed. Not an ad. It has to stop a scroll with the sound off and get watched twice. Plus two alternate openings on the same body, so we can see how you think about hooks.



Both are held to a real craft spec: neutral, cinematic color that holds skin tones across every environment, sound design nobody notices, and clean captions.



What we're judging: clip selection, color consistency, whether you found something worth saying in the raw audio, restraint, and whether we're hooked in the first three seconds.



That's how we'll know. It's also how you'll know whether you actually want to work with us.



Turnaround once you're in: five business days for new projects, two for revisions, unless agreed otherwise.



On compensation: we're not posting a range. What you're worth depends on what you bring, and we'd rather stretch for the right person than save money on the wrong one. Tell us your number and we'll have a real conversation.

Logistics: fully remote, flexible schedule, with overlap for feedback and check-ins. Room to grow into creative leadership as the video side scales.



TO APPLY

 
 with the subject line: [Your Full Name] | Senior Video Editor



Include:

- Your résumé (PDF)

- Portfolio links with both long-form and short-form work

- The three pieces that best represent you, and what exactly you did on each

- Your current employment or client commitments

- Your expected monthly rate

- A 1–3 minute Loom: why this role, and what you loved and hated about your last gig



Then answer these. There are a lot, and some won't look like they're about editing. That's on purpose.

1. Link the piece you're proudest of. What did the raw footage look like, and what's one choice in the edit that most editors wouldn't have made?

2. Link a piece you'd recut if you could. What would you change?

3. We hand you an hour of raw podcast audio and b-roll from six locations, and ask for a 30–45 second direct response ad at an A+ level. How long would that take you? Give us a number.

4. Why that number? Walk us through your process.

5. What's a video (not yours) you've watched more than five times? Why does it work?

6. How do you d
 when to hold a shot versus cut?

7. A client's only note is "make it pop." What do you do?

8. Tell us about a workflow you simplified. What was broken, what did you change, what happened?

9. What important truth do very few people agree with you on?

10. What's one book or film that stuck with you this year, and why?

11. Are you delusional about what you can accomplish? Do you believe you can make anything put in front of you great?



IMPORTANT: INCOMPLETE APPLICATIONS WON'T BE CONSIDERED.



If you're a fit, we'll get on a call and you'll walk us through a timeline you've actually cut.

— Yewan, Tulen Agency

title: Real Estate Acquisition Specialist (Remote, Investor-Focused)
description:
We are a growing U.S.-based real estate investment company looking for a **highly skilled Real Estate Acquisition Specialist / Closer** to join our team long-term.



This is **not primarily a cold-calling position**. Our marketing and lead-generation team identifies homeowners who have expressed interest in selling and pre-qualifies them before handing qualified opportunities to the Acquisition Specialist.



Your primary responsibility will be to speak with motivated homeowners, understand their situation, build trust, negotiate pricing and terms, follow up consistently, and ultimately **get profitable real estate contracts signed**.



We currently generate seller opportunities through multiple channels, including **iSpeedToLead, DataSift, SMS marketing, Smarter Contact, Kixie, and our CRM**. Our goal is to build a highly systemized acquisition department where qualified seller opportunities are contacted quickly and no valuable lead falls through the cracks.



Our primary transaction strategy is **novation**, followed by wholesale/assignment when appropriate. We selectively purchase properties ourselves when the profit opportunity is exceptional.



You will work closely with our current Acquisition Manager, operations team, lead-generation team, and company owner. Initially, you will learn our existing acquisition process and work alongside our current Acquisition Manager. The goal is for you to eventually become capable of **independently managing and closing qualified seller opportunities from beginning to end**.



### Responsibilities & Expectations



- Call qualified homeowners who have indicated an interest in selling.

- Respond quickly to newly qualified seller opportunities.

- Build rapport and uncover the seller's true motivation, timeline, condition, financial situation, and desired outcome.

- Negotiate purchase prices and transaction structures professionally and confidently.

- Explain cash offers, novation transactions, and other selling solutions clearly to homeowners.

- Maintain consistent follow-up with sellers who are not ready to make a decision immediately.

- Work leads through the CRM until they sell, contract with us, or are otherwise no longer viable.

- Use **Kixie** for outbound calling and follow-up.

- Maintain detailed CRM notes so another team member can immediately understand each seller's situation.

- Work closely with the lead-qualification team to improve the quality of leads being transferred to acquisitions.

- Bring complicated or unusually valuable opportunities to management for deal review.

- Participate in call reviews, coaching, and ongoing sales training.

- Become capable of covering for the Acquisition Manager when he is unavailable.

- Ultimately produce approximately **4–6 signed contracts per month** once fully trained and supplied with adequate qualified lead volume.



## Who We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who is **comfortable talking about money, asking difficult questions, negotiating, handling objections, and asking homeowners to make decisions**.



The ideal candidate has prior experience in **U.S. real estate acquisitions, wholesaling, investor sales, high-ticket telephone sales, or another negotiation-heavy sales position**.



Excellent spoken English is extremely important. You should sound natural, confident, professional, empathetic, and trustworthy when speaking with U.S. homeowners.



You should also be:



- Highly dependable and available during agreed U.S. business hours.

- Competitive but ethical.

- Persistent without being aggressive.

- Comfortable receiving coaching and having calls reviewed.

- Organized with strong CRM discipline.

- Able to follow a sales process while still thinking independently.

- Comfortable making numerous follow-up calls every day.

- Able to recognize seller motivation and negotiate creatively.

- Comfortable discussing property values, mortgages, equity, repairs, and seller expectations.

- Motivated by measurable results rather than simply completing tasks.



## What This Job Is NOT



This is not a position where success is measured by simply making a large number of calls.



We care about:



**Qualified seller conversations → signed contracts → closed transactions → gross profit.**



Our lead-generation team will do much of the initial prospecting and qualification. Your job is to take valuable seller opportunities and **convert them into contracts**.



## Training & Growth



You will initially work closely with our existing Acquisition Manager and review real seller conversations, successful deals, objection handling, negotiation strategies, and our novation process.



We are building redundancy into our acquisition department, so our objective is to have **multiple Acquisition Specialists capable of independently closing deals at a high level**.



Strong performers will have opportunities to take on significantly more responsibility as the company grows.



## Schedule



**Full-time position.**



You must be able to work hours that overlap substantially with U.S. business hours and be available when homeowners are most likely to answer their phones.



Exact schedule will be discussed during the interview.



## Compensation



**Competitive base compensation plus performance incentives/bonuses based on results.**



Compensation will depend on experience, communication ability, and demonstrated sales skill.



Top performers should have the opportunity to earn substantially more as their contract production increases.



## How to Apply



Please include the following with your application:



1. A short explanation of your previous sales, real estate, acquisitions, or negotiation experience.

2. Your experience speaking with U.S.-based customers.

3. Your experience using CRMs and telephone dialing systems.

4. Your experience with real estate wholesaling, acquisitions, novations, or motivated sellers, if applicable.

5. A **60–90 second voice recording** introducing yourself and explaining why you believe you would be successful negotiating with U.S. homeowners.

6. Your desired hourly/monthly compensation.

7. Your internet speed and backup internet/power setup.

8. Put the words **“Acquisition Closer”** in the subject line of your application so we know you carefully read the entire job description.



**VOICE RECORDING MANDATORY**. Since this person's job is almost entirely seller communication,

title: Senior FP&A / Financial Modeling Analyst
description:
Senior FP&A / Financial Modeling Analyst

Remote – Philippines | Full-Time

About the Role

A growing U.S.-based company is looking for a highly analytical Senior FP&A / Financial Modeling Analyst to support its Finance team.

This role will work closely with senior Finance leadership and will focus heavily on financial modeling, forecasting, profitability analysis, pricing, margins, and management decision support.

This is not a traditional accounting or bookkeeping position. We are looking for someone who can take financial and operational data, build reliable models, identify trends and opportunities, and turn the results into forward-looking analysis that helps management make better business decisions.

Key Responsibilities

- Build and maintain detailed financial models for revenue, gross profit, gross margin, EBITDA, and overall profitability.

- Develop product-level pricing and margin models incorporating selling price, product cost, freight, duties/tariffs, and other landed costs.

- Analyze gross margins against company targets and identify products, customers, or transactions that are below target.

- Develop scenario and sensitivity models to evaluate the impact of changes in:

  - Selling prices

  - Product costs

  - Freight and shipping methods

  - Duties and tariffs

  - Sales volume

  - Product mix

  - Other operating assumptions

- Analyze different shipping and sourcing scenarios and determine their impact on landed cost, gross margin, and profitability.

- Identify pricing opportunities and determine the selling prices required to achieve targeted gross margins.

- Develop models showing the financial impact of pricing increases, purchasing savings, freight savings, and other cost-reduction opportunities.

- Build and maintain EBITDA forecasts and bridge analyses showing the impact of pricing, volume, product mix, gross margin, freight, purchasing savings, and operating expenses.

- Support annual budgeting, monthly forecasting, and longer-term financial planning.

- Perform actual vs. budget and actual vs. forecast analysis and explain the key drivers behind variances.

- Analyze historical financial and operational trends and develop forward-looking projections.

- Work with large datasets from accounting, ERP, sales, inventory, purchasing, and other business systems.

- Develop management dashboards and reports that clearly identify trends, risks, opportunities, and areas requiring management action.

- Perform product, customer, and business-line profitability analysis.

- Work closely with Finance and IT to improve the accuracy, efficiency, and automation of financial analysis and reporting.

- Perform ad hoc financial modeling and analysis requested by senior management.

- Present findings in a clear and concise manner and provide actionable financial insights rather than simply reporting numbers.

Required Qualifications

- Minimum 5 years of experience in FP&A, corporate finance, financial analysis, or financial modeling.

- Demonstrated experience building sophisticated financial models from the ground up.

- Advanced Excel and/or Google Sheets skills.

- Strong understanding of revenue, COGS, gross profit, gross margin, EBITDA, operating expenses, and working capital.

- Strong experience with budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis.

- Experience with pricing, profitability, margin, and scenario/sensitivity analysis.

- Ability to work with large and sometimes complex datasets.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Ability to identify the business drivers behind financial results rather than simply reporting variances.

- Strong attention to detail and ability to independently validate financial information.

- Ability to translate complex financial analysis into clear recommendations for management.

- Comfortable working directly with senior Finance and company leadership.

- Strong written and spoken English.

- Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

- Ability to work U.S. business hours as required.

Preferred Qualifications

- CPA, CMA, CFA, MBA, or similar professional qualification is a plus but not required.

- Experience with Power BI, Power Query, SQL, or similar business intelligence/data tools.

- Experience with QuickBooks Online, ERP systems, or similar accounting and operational systems.

- Experience working with manufacturing, distribution, wholesale, consumer products, inventory-intensive businesses, or landed-cost analysis.

- Experience analyzing freight, logistics, tariffs, duties, sourcing, or supply-chain costs.

- Experience using AI or other modern analytical tools to improve financial analysis, forecasting, scenario modeling, or reporting.

What Success Looks Like

The successful candidate should be able to take management questions such as:

“If we change our shipping method, what happens to landed cost and gross margin?”

“What selling price do we need to maintain our target gross margin?”

“Which products or customers are generating margins below our target, and why?”

“If product costs increase or decrease, what pricing changes are required to protect margin?”

“Where are our biggest opportunities to improve profitability?”

“What combination of pricing, margin improvement, sales growth, and cost reductions will allow us to achieve our annual EBITDA target?”

The expectation is not simply to provide numbers, but to build the model, analyze the results, identify the key drivers, and provide management with actionable insights.

Application Requirements

Please submit your resume along with a brief description of your FP&A and financial modeling experience.

In your application, please specifically describe:

- Financial models you have personally built.

- Your experience with pricing and gross-margin analysis.

- Your experience with forecasting and scenario/sensitivity modeling.

- Your experience building EBITDA or profitability forecasts.

- The most advanced Excel or Google Sheets model you have developed.

- Any experience with Power BI, Power Query, SQL, AI, or other analytical tools.

Examples of previous financial models or dashboards may be requested during the interview process. Please do not provide confidential information belonging to a current or former employer.

Shortlisted candidates will be required to complete a practical financial modeling assessment.

title: Admin Opening - Operations Manager in Training — The Florida Maid (MUST BE ALL IN!)
description:
The Florida Maid is ready to operate.



Customers are already calling every day. Applicants are already waiting for work. The website, technology, systems, customer demand, and recruiting pipeline already exist.

It doesn't need another idea.

It needs someone to run it.

We are hiring an Administrator, Operations who will start by learning the daily operation and be trained to become an Operations Manager responsible for running and growing The Florida Maid.

We are ready to hire today.

This is not a traditional VA position

We are looking for someone who is:

Fast. Hungry. Confident. Aggressive about results. Comfortable under pressure.

You cannot be someone who waits around for instructions while customers are waiting.

You need to see something that needs to happen and make it happen.

By aggressive, we don't mean rude. We mean you follow up, solve problems, ask for the sale, recruit the worker, respond immediately, and close the loop.

Your mission

The business already has demand.

Your job is to turn that demand into customers, completed services, repeat business and growth.

You will learn to:

- Answer inbound calls, SMS,
 and chat quickly

- Convert leads into booked customers

- Follow up aggressively on unconverted opportunities

- Manage bookings and schedules

- Recruit, qualify and onboard cleaners

- Coordinate cleaners and customers

- Monitor jobs throughout the day

- Handle cancellations and last-minute problems

- Resolve unhappy-customer situations

- Monitor payments

- Generate repeat business

- Increase revenue and average order value

- Track daily performance

- Identify problems before they become emergencies

- Help expand The Florida Maid throughout Florida

You'll operate through Full Loop CRM, the technology platform that connects communications, customers, bookings, scheduling, workers, payments and business operations.

Compensation & growth

Starting pay: $200 USD/week

The first 4 weeks are your trial period.

Successfully complete the trial and your base compensation increases to:

$250 USD/week

You will receive a clear compensation and performance schedule covering your first six months, so you'll understand exactly how increased responsibility and strong performance can lead to increased compensation.

And advancement can happen significantly faster for exceptional performers.

Others in this type of position have progressed from $200/week to $500/week within their first month based on performance and increased responsibility.

There is also an opportunity for performance/profit participation tied to revenue sold/generated.

We want the person helping grow the business to have meaningful upside from helping create that growth.

Operations Manager in Training

The title is intentional.

We are not looking for someone to remain an administrator forever.

The path is:

Administrator → prove yourself → increased responsibility → Operations Manager.

An Operations Manager ultimately owns:

Customers. Cleaners. Revenue. Operations. Growth.

Your advancement will depend on what you demonstrate—not simply how long you've worked here.

Speed matters

Customers are already contacting The Florida Maid every day.

Every missed call, unanswered message and slow follow-up can represent lost revenue.

title: Real Estate Media Quality Control VA

title: ClickUp Traffic Manager (PH)
description:
ClickUp Traffic Manager (PH)



We're looking for a Traffic Manager to become the nerve center of Marketing Services' ClickUp queue — catching blocked tasks before they turn into missed deadlines, chasing down the information that's holding work up, and giving leadership a real-time view of where every campaign actually stands.



You'll also be stepping into a role built from the ground up: the dashboards, SLAs, and cross-team relationships you establish in your first year will become the default way Moxie tracks marketing work as we scale.



As Moxie grows past 1,000+ medspa providers without proportional headcount growth, campaign work is increasingly getting stuck in ClickUp for lack of a dedicated owner watching the queue. Right now, unblocking a task means someone — often a campaign builder or account lead — stops what they're doing to chase down status. This role exists to take that job off their plate entirely, so they can focus on execution instead of status-chasing.





Our objectives for the role

- Fully ramp on Marketing Services' ClickUp structure (spaces, lists, custom fields, automations) and start actively triaging the daily task queue within your first few weeks

- Build a ClickUp dashboard that gives PSMs a clear, at-a-glance view of task status, blockers, and overdue work for their practices

- Own daily traffic management as a standing responsibility, resolving blocked or stuck tasks within an agreed SLA, and show measurable improvement in task turnaround time or the volume of aged tasks

- Establish a reliable, repeatable process for chasing missing information from onboarding managers, marketing services team members, and PSMs

- Mature ClickUp dashboards and traffic processes into the team's default source of truth for "where is this task" — reducing ad hoc Slack status-checks — and surface systemic bottlenecks (not just individual stuck tasks) to the right owner with data





We're looking for:

- Someone who's been the "glue" person on a team before — traffic, project coordination, ops — and wants that work recognized and owned outright, not treated as a side responsibility

- Comfort getting fluent in ClickUp, HubSpot, and the CSP quickly enough to pull the context needed to unblock a task without looping in someone else first

- A track record of building dashboards or reporting views that people actually use, and iterating on them based on what the team needs next

- Someone energized by order and visibility rather than by doing the creative or strategic work themselves

- Judgment to distinguish an individual stuck task from a systemic bottleneck — and the initiative to bring the latter to the right owner with data, not just a complaint





Why Join us?

- Above all, we're in this to empower small business owners to own and grow their businesses. If you succeed, Med Spas will remain the opportunity for independent owner-operators instead of being dominated by a small number of large chains. If that speaks to you, speak to us.

- We have much left to build. But given the market feedback we're getting and our founding team's company-building experience, we think we are writing the first chapters of a real success story.

- This is a role built from scratch — the systems and processes you put in place become the team's operating model, not a slot you're filling in an existing one.

- Competitive salary





Please apply using the link below:

Number of phone calls handled by team members.

Workflow and task completion metrics.

Other operational KPIs requested by management.

Maintain accurate reporting data and identify inconsistencies before reports are submitted.

Assist leadership with gathering and organizing information needed for operational decision-making.

Provide cross-functional administrative and operational support to the tax and accounting teams.

Monitor shared
 inboxes and organize incoming receipts, documents, and client correspondence.

Maintain organized digital files and documentation within Google Drive and other company systems.

Assist with identifying and resolving administrative or workflow issues.

Communicate clearly with internal team members regarding deadlines, missing information, and outstanding tasks.

Assist with improving and documenting internal processes as the firm's systems and workflows evolve.

Perform other operational and administrative tasks as needed.

Compliance & Confidentiality

Maintain strict confidentiality when handling client financial, tax, and personal information.

Follow company policies and established procedures for handling financial and client documentation.

Ensure records are complete, accurate, and properly maintained.

Follow applicable accounting, tax-office, and data-handling procedures.

Maintain organized documentation for internal reviews and audits when applicable.

Software & Technology

Utilize practice-management and workflow systems to track client engagements and assignments.

Utilize electronic signature and client portal platforms.

Quickly learn and adapt to new software, systems, and technology.

This position will communicate with clients, team members, and leadership through

This role is execution-focused: the founder sets strategy and provides AI-drafted content; you build, launch, manage, and report. You will work heavily with AI tools — we expect it — but you must be able to operate the platforms yourself, live.



What you will do:



1. Manage paid ads on Meta and Google from provided campaign structure: tracking setup (UTMs, pixel/CAPI), budget management, weekly reporting. Ads launch only after tracking is verified.



2.  Run outbound distribution: LinkedIn engagement and scheduling for the founder's account,
 group participation (Phase 1); webinar promotion and referral partner follow-up sequences (Phase 2)



3. Edit, format, and publish SEO articles from AI-assisted drafts (all content physician-reviewed before publishing) — ongoing cadence of 2/week is Phase 2 scope; Phase 1 focuses on the attribution/sequence/reactivation/ads build



4. Build and manage
 campaigns and automations in GoHighLevel from provided sequence specs (new-lead follow-up, reactivation, newsletter)



5. Maintain CRM hygiene and produce a weekly one-page report: leads, cost per lead,
 metrics, pipeline contribution





Requirements: 

- 5+ years marketing execution for US clients — you have personally run paid campaigns and built marketing automations at real volume, not coordinated a team that did; 

- hands-on GoHighLevel (or HubSpot/ActiveCampaign + fast GHL ramp); 

- personally managed Meta/Google campaigns including tracking; 

- excellent written English; fixed daily overlap hours with US Eastern, with same-day response on urgent items during that window (in writing in the offer).



Compensation — two phases, both stated here. This is a remote, globally-sourced role, and the rate below reflects an international market rate rather than a US-based salary.



Phase 1 (Days 1–30, full-time build): $1,200–$2,000/month based on experience — roughly $7–$12/hour. Default length is 30 days; may finish sooner for a strong performer with no reduction in the month's pay. Extends day-for-day at the full Phase 1 rate only if the delay is caused by APH (review turnaround, account access, portal) — not for candidate pace.



Phase 2 (Day 31 onward): part-time at ~20–25 hrs/week, with pay scaled proportionally from the Phase 1 rate and a small fixed daily overlap with US Eastern hours so urgent items still get a same-day response, both stated in writing.



Bonus: $150–$300/month on qualified-lead targets, carried through both phases and becoming a larger share of total pay once base hours drop.



Day-30 fork (APH's option, not a promise): if performance clearly warrants it, APH may keep this hire full-time at the Phase 1 rate with expanded scope folded in (CRM ownership, proposal support, follow-up sequencing) instead of converting to part-time.



Paid live working session before hire.

s introducing Brake World

Location: Remote

Compensation: $750 – $800 / month

We are looking for a highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented Office Administrator & Operations Assistant with strong experience in the finance, accounting, or CPA sector to join our growing team. In this dual-function role, you will act as the operational backbone of our practice—providing executive support to leadership, managing sensitive client communications, and assisting our Operations Manager with daily workflows, compliance schedules, and administrative tasks.

- Priority Management & Follow-Up: Triage incoming requests, flag high-priority client inquiries, and maintain meticulous follow-up tracking to eliminate missed deliverables.



Operations & Firm Administration

- Workflow & Tax/Audit Deadline Tracking: Monitor internal client engagement pipelines using practice management software, ensuring key filing, reporting, and review deadlines are consistently met.

- Administrative Operations & File Integrity: Assist operations with client intake records, secure file management, electronic signature routing (e.g., e-signatures for engagement letters/tax returns), and accurate data entry.

- Internal Communications: Ensure firm updates, policy reminders, and tax-season operational guidelines are communicated clearly across departments.

- Client & Employee Onboarding: Facilitate client onboarding routines and assist with internal staff onboarding, including access setup, document collection, and orientation scheduling.

- Team Events & Logistics: Organize virtual team gatherings, busy-season moral checks, and internal practice meetings.



Qualifications

- Required Experience: 2+ years of hands-on experience in an EA, Administrative Assistant, or Operations Assistant role specifically within a CPA firm, accounting practice, or corporate finance team.

- Accounting/Finance Acumen: Practical understanding of accounting firm operations, confidentiality rules, engagement lifecycles, and key compliance deadlines.

- Communication Skills: Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills, with a track record of drafting articulate, polished
 correspondence for financial clients.

- Organization & Adaptability: Outstanding time-management skills with the ability to prioritize tasks independently during high-volume periods (e.g., tax season / quarter-end).

- Professional Integrity: Strict commitment to client privacy, confidentiality, and financial data security best practices.

title: Recruiter
description:
Our company is on a mission to redefine the way job seekers navigate their next career move. As a Reverse Recruiter, you will play a key role in this transformation, acting not just as a guide, but as a dedicated recruiter focused on helping our clients secure and land meaningful job opportunities.



In this role, you will partner closely with job seekers, taking the time to deeply understand their professional background, career goals, and personal preferences. You will then proactively identify, pursue, and match them with opportunities that align with their aspirations. Your work will directly impact their success by positioning them competitively in the job market and increasing their chances of getting hired.



Key Responsibilities:

• Build strong relationships with clients, serving as their recruiter, advisor, and advocate throughout their job search journey.

• Actively source and identify job opportunities that align with each client’s experience, skills, and career goals.

• Manage and maintain a consistent pipeline of relevant job postings tailored to each client.

• Evaluate job postings to ensure they meet client criteria and present strong placement potential.

• Support clients in the application process by guiding them on where and how to apply effectively.

• Serve as the main point of contact, providing ongoing support, updates, and strategic advice.

• Meet and exceed daily targets related to job sourcing and application activity.



Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree or higher preferred.

• Strong command of English, with the ability to communicate clearly and professionally.

• Excellent organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple clients and priorities.

• Strong interpersonal skills with a genuine passion for helping others succeed.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office and related tools.

• Proven ability to meet or exceed performance targets.

• At least 2 years of experience in recruiting or talent acquisition.



This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a results-driven environment and is passionate about helping people land jobs that align with their goals. As a Reverse Recruiter, your success is measured by your ability to connect clients with the right opportunities—and ultimately help them secure their next role.

To apply

Senior Accountant (Remote) | Ledger



Close the books. Lead the team. Automate the busywork.



Ledger is an accounting firm for US startups and small businesses. We handle full-cycle accounting and financial reporting, and we use automation and AI to move faster without cutting corners.



We're hiring a Senior Accountant who can do the work, review it, and lead the people doing it. You'll own the close for a set of clients, manage a small team, run projects from start to finish, and help us find smarter ways to handle the manual parts of accounting.



What you'll do



Own the close



Run the monthly close for your client portfolio: reconciliations, accruals, prepaids, fixed assets, deferred revenue, and financial statements

Keep bank, card, payroll, and spend platform activity flowing cleanly into the GL

Prepare adjusting entries with clear support behind every line

Build workpapers that tie back to source reports

Write short commentary a founder can read in a minute



Lead and develop people



Review staff and junior accountant work before it reaches the client

Assign work, set priorities, and keep closes on schedule

Give clear review notes and coach on the "why" behind each correction

Spot repeat issues and fix them at the source



Run projects



Lead cleanups, catch-up work, system migrations, and new client onboarding

Scope the work, set the timeline, and own the outcome



Build with AI and automation



Use tools like Claude and Codex every day, from ledger review and commentary to reconciliations and workpapers

Build and maintain workflows that remove manual steps from the close: transaction coding, rec matching, JE imports, and client requests

Check AI output with the same care you'd give a teammate's work

Share what works so the whole team gets better



Work with clients



Be a go-to contact for founders and finance teams

Ask for what you need, explain findings plainly, and join close reviews



What you bring



4+ years in accounting, with at least 2 in a firm, audit, or multi-client role

Experience reviewing work and managing or mentoring staff

Solid US GAAP: accruals, revenue recognition, prepaids, fixed assets, and leases

Advanced QuickBooks Online, plus experience with Gusto and Ramp

Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills (linked formulas, not typed-in numbers)

Comfort running several closes at once and hitting deadlines

Clear, simple written English and strong communication

A proactive, problem-solving mindset

Professional skepticism: when something doesn't tie, you find out why instead of forcing it



Nice to have



Hands-on experience with Claude, Codex, ChatGPT, or similar tools

Workflow building with Zapier, Make, or simple scripts

CPA (US or PH), or working toward it

E-commerce or startup accounting experience

System migrations or historical cleanups



How we work



Every number traces to support

Work gets reviewed before it goes to a client

If a task repeats, we automate it

We write plainly, with no jargon in anything a client reads



Ready to build a better close with us? Send your CV to

title: Bookkeeper with QBO experience
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

We are looking for a detail-oriented Bookkeeper to oversee the organization's financial record-keeping to ensure the business can make sound financial decisions. This position will be responsible for producing monthly financial reports, maintaining an adequate accounting record system, and managing a comprehensive set of controls, budgets, and forecasting to mitigate risks. The Bookkeeper will play a key role in enhancing the accuracy of the company’s reported financial results and ensuring those results comply with generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP) and bookkeeping principles and procedures. This position will report directly to the Finance Manager.





This position is 100% remote.





ABOUT CARDONE VENTURES

Our mission is to help business owners achieve their personal, professional, and financial goals through the growth of their businesses. We work in dozens of verticals and provide strategic business guidance through courses, live events, partnerships, and investments. Our core values are the backbone of our business and guide our hiring process: we are inspirational, disciplined, accountable, transparent, aligned, and results-oriented. This company operates nationally and is growing by the day.

Wondering what it's like to work here? Come check this:


/watch?v=PIIv7sYj1Ns





SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

- Timely and accurate delivery of monthly financial reports, reconciliations, and compliance filings

- Organized and auditable accounting systems with well-maintained digital records and controls

- Budgets and forecasts are submitted on time with clear variance analysis and actionable insights

- All payables, debt obligations, and tax filings are completed without delays or errors

- Trusted financial insights that support business decisions and reflect a strong understanding of GAAP principles





OBJECTIVES

- Maintain an accurate and timely record of all financial transactions and issue timely and complete financial statements

- Perform account reconciliation to assert the accuracy of transactions and entries in the accounting system

- Develop a documented system of accounting policies and procedures

- Monitor the accounting operations of subsidiary entities, transaction-processing operations, and policies and procedures

- Develop professionally by remaining aware of new state and federal regulations, participating in educational opportunities, and reading professional publications

- Ensure that all accounts payable are paid timely manner and all reasonable discounts are taken on invoices

- Ensure that monthly bank and credit card reconciliations are completed

- Ensure that required debt payments (company credit cards, loans, or lines of credit) are paid on a timely basis

- Develop and maintain an orderly accounting filing system (digital)

- Maintain a system of controls over accounting transactions

- Manage the production of the annual budget and forecasts

- Calculate variances from the budget and report significant issues to ownership

- Calculate and issue financial and operating metrics

- Coordinate the preparation and compilation of year-end reporting and financial statements

- Report and file state sales and use tax

- Reconcile all balance sheet accounts monthly

- Perform other duties as assigned



COMPETENCIES

- Demonstrates solid GAAP and financial reporting, technical skills

- Demonstrates proficiency with QuickBooks, XERO or other accounting software, MS Office Suite, Adobe, Windows, DocuSign, Google Suite

- Proactive approach to problem-solving and process improvement

- Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment of change and growth

- Demonstrates knowledge of auditing, accounting, and corporate financing

- Possesses strong written and verbal communication skills, clearly communicating by phone or in person with team members

- Ability to prioritize multiple tasks and responsibilities

- Demonstrates a working knowledge of taxation and corporate structures

- Ability to successfully maintain a positive attitude while working in a team environment with competing priorities

- Possesses outstanding organizational and administrative skills



EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

- Bachelor’s degree in accounting and finance, or equivalent business experience

- Minimum 3 years of progressive experience in bookkeeping

- Experience working with multiple legal entities under a legal umbrella

- Experience with financial reporting requirements



PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer





COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY

As an equal opportunity employer committed to meeting the needs of a multigenerational and multicultural workforce, Highland Park Lapidary recognizes that a diverse staff, reflective of our community, is an integral and welcome part of a successful and ethical business. We hire local talent at all levels regardless of race, color, religion, age, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, or disability, and actively foster inclusion in all forms both within our company and across interactions with clients, candidates, and partners.





If this position caught your eye, send us your resume! For best consideration, please complete the online application form:

title: Social Media Management/Advertising [Peptide Company]
description:
FULL-TIME SOCIAL MEDIA VA / CONTENT MANAGER – PEPTIDE COMPANY



We are a growing peptide company looking for a proactive, organised and creative full-time Social Media VA / Content Manager to manage our day-to-day social media content.



POSTING REQUIREMENTS



• TikTok: 4–5 videos per account per day × 3 accounts = 12–15 videos daily

• Instagram: 2–3 Reels + 1 feed/carousel post per account × 3 accounts = 6–9 Reels + 3 feed posts daily

•
: 2 posts/Reels per account × 3 accounts = 6 posts/Reels daily

• X 
): 3–5 posts per account × 3 accounts = 9–15 posts daily

• 3 active accounts per platform



• Content can and should be repurposed/recycled across platforms and accounts where appropriate. We do NOT expect every single post to be completely unique.

• Daily comment & DM engagement

• Daily trend/content research

• Track views, engagement, clicks & conversions

• Maintain consistent posting and content quality

• All content must comply with each platform’s rules





THE ROLE



You will be responsible for creating, editing, scheduling and posting content across our social media accounts.



We will supply you with some content and raw video footage, which you will need to edit into professional and engaging short-form videos.



However, we will also expect you to come up with your own content ideas and create content yourself. You should be proactive rather than relying entirely on content supplied by us.



This will include researching trends, competitors, viral content, hooks and ideas and turning them into interesting content for our peptide brand.



Good-performing content can be repurposed across TikTok, Instagram,
 and X and used across different accounts where appropriate. This means the posting numbers above do NOT represent completely unique pieces of content every day.



You should be confident using CapCut or similar video-editing software and Canva for graphics, carousels and other social content.



You will also manage the content calendar, engage with comments and DMs and monitor which content generates the most views, engagement, clicks and conversions.



All content must be created with platform compliance in mind. We want to build professional, long-term social media accounts and grow the brand sustainably.





WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



• Experience with TikTok, Instagram Reels and short-form content

• Good video-editing skills

• Experience with CapCut or similar software

• Experience with Canva

• Strong written English

• Good organisational and time-management skills

• Comfortable managing multiple social media accounts

• Basic understanding of social media analytics

• Able to work independently and come up with your own ideas

• Willing to learn about peptides and our products



Experience with peptides, health, wellness or supplements is an advantage but is not essential.





HOURS & SALARY



• Full-time position

• 40 hours per week

• Monday–Friday

• Starting salary: $650 USD per month

• Salary and performance review after 2–3 months



After 2–3 months, your performance and salary will be reviewed based on the quality of your work, reliability, ability to manage the workload independently, content performance and your overall contribution to the business.



Strong performance can lead to an increase in salary and further opportunities within the company.



We are looking for someone who wants a stable, long-term position and can eventually take ownership of our day-to-day social media operation.





WHEN APPLYING, PLEASE SEND:



1. Examples of social media accounts you have managed.

2. Examples of short-form videos or content you have created.

3. Which video-editing/design software you use.

4. Your experience with CapCut and Canva.

5. Any experience with health, wellness, supplements or peptides.

6. Confirmation that you are available to work 40 hours per week.

$6–$8 USD/hour | Full-Time | Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Central Time



Every day, dozens of cleaning appointments depend on someone noticing small scheduling problems before they become big ones.



We are looking for that person.

-Customer phone support experience

-Dispatch or logistics experience

-Google Workspace

-Fluent spoken and written English

-Reliable computer and dedicated workspace

-Reliable internet connection with a backup option

-Backup power solution

-No work for another employer or client during scheduled working hours



Compensation



$6–$8 USD per hour, based on directly relevant experience.



Candidates with direct Jobber experience, mobile-team scheduling experience, and strong customer phone skills will receive priority consideration.



Our Core Values

-Communication

-Connection

-Quality

-Service

-Teamwork

Please make your answers specific and based on your actual experience.
