title: VA Real Estate Cold Call Closer
description:
Skybound Wealth Group is a fast-growing real estate company looking for a driven, results-oriented Virtual Assistant who can take ownership of our outbound sales pipeline — from first dial to signed deal.

You'll be the first voice prospects hear and the closer that gets them to yes, backed by strong systems and a supportive team.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Cold Calling: Around 3,000 calls per day, high-volume outbound calls to motivated seller and buyer leads.

Sales Closing: Qualify, nurture, and convert leads into agreements.

Lead Management: Organize, track, and follow up on leads at every stage of the pipeline.

CRM Integration: Update and maintain pipelines in real time (Follow Up Boss, HubSpot, Podio, or similar).

Appointment Setting: Schedule consultations and property walkthroughs for our agents.

Pipeline Reporting: Provide daily summaries, KPI tracking, and conversion notes.

Strategic Relationship Development — 25% of Role: Build genuine relationships with people and businesses that can create additional deal flow for Skybound Wealth Group, including real estate agents, investors, wholesalers, and other local professionals.

Off-Market Opportunity Development: Identify potential deal sources and referral relationships that our normal marketing and lead-generation systems would not reach.

Relationship Building: Maintain and grow a network of people who can refer distressed properties, motivated sellers, off-market opportunities, or other potential deals to the company.

Your 25% Strategic Mission

Your job is to find people who can bring us opportunities that our normal marketing machine would never find.

This is not simply a networking task. The goal is to create a new, relationship-driven acquisition channel for the company that can grow alongside our outbound marketing.

REQUIREMENTS

Proven experience in cold calling, telemarketing, or inside sales (real estate background is a strong plus).

Confident, persuasive communicator with excellent English — spoken and written.

Hands-on experience with CRM platforms (Follow Up Boss, HubSpot, Podio, or similar).

Highly organized, able to manage high call volumes and multiple pipelines simultaneously.

Strong relationship-building and networking skills.

Comfortable speaking with business owners, investors, agents, contractors, and other professionals.

Self-motivated, competitive, and goal-driven.

Able to work independently and take ownership of results.

Reliable remote setup: high-speed internet, quiet workspace, and quality headset.

WHAT WE OFFER

$480/month base pay + performance bonuses per closed deal

100% remote work.

Paid training and scripts provided.

Growth opportunities within the company.

Opportunity to grow into a larger sales, business development, or leadership role as the company scales.

title: Xactimate Estimator- Fire & Water Damage Restoration
description:

We're looking for an experienced Xactimate estimator to join our remote team long-term.



The Role



You will write mitigation estimates in Xactimate based on job files we send you. Each job file includes:

Photos of the loss

Documentation (moisture readings, drying logs, equipment logs, sketches/measurements)

A written scope of work from our field team

Your job is to turn that file into a complete, accurate, carrier-ready Xactimate estimate.

Responsibilities

Write water and fire mitigation estimates in Xactimate (X1-3 online)

Create or verify sketches from provided measurements

Apply correct line items for water extraction, demolition, drying equipment, cleaning, and content manipulation

Follow IICRC S500/S520 standards and carrier guidelines

Ensure estimates are complete — no missed line items — and defensible to adjusters

Make revisions based on adjuster feedback or reviewer notes

Meet turnaround deadlines (typically 24 hours from receiving a complete job file)

Communicate clearly with our team about missing documentation or scope questions



Requirements

2+ years of hands-on Xactimate estimating experience, specifically in water and/or fire mitigation & Reconstruction

Strong understanding of the mitigation process: extraction, demo, drying, equipment placement and duration

Familiarity with insurance carrier requirements and common pushback (e.g., equipment justification, per-day charges)

Excellent written English

Reliable internet and computer capable of running Xactimate

Able to overlap with US Central Time for at least 2–3 hours daily

Detail-oriented — you catch what others miss

Nice to Have

IICRC WRT/ASD certification or equivalent knowledge

Experience with Dash, Encircle, Docusketch, or similar documentation platforms

Experience with Xactimate sketch from Matterport or field measurements

Experience writing fire/smoke estimates (cleaning, sealing, pack-out)

title: Tax Strategy Assistant
description:
Tax Strategy Assistant

Company: BEC CFO & CPA LLC

Reports to: Tax Strategy Lead / Director of Tax

Employment type: Full-time

Location: Fully remote - International candidates welcome

Hours: Core overlap required with US Eastern Time business hours



About BEC CFO & CPA LLC



BEC CFO & CPA LLC is an accounting, CFO advisory, and tax firm serving business owners and

real estate investors. Our tax strategy work goes well beyond compliance: we build proactive, documented planning strategies that reduce our clients' lifetime tax liability and support real business decisions. We operate on modern cloud systems, standardized workflows, and a strong quality-review culture .



Role summary

The Tax Strategy Assistant is the engine behind our tax planning work. You will gather, organize , and verify the financial and legal data our strategists need — then transform it into clean, decision-ready analysis. This is a detail-intensive, document-heavy role for someone who enjoys reconciling messy source material into a single reliable picture of a client's tax position. You will not be preparing planning strategies on your own at the outset. You will be the person who makes sure the data behind every strategy is complete, accurate, tied out, and ready for review.



Key responsibilities

Data gathering and preparation

Pull and organize client financial data from cloud accounting systems, including trial balances, general ledger detail,

P&Ls, and balance sheets

Extract and summarize relevant figures from prior-year federal and state tax returns for individuals, partnerships, S corporations, and C corporations

Review and reconcile fixed asset and depreciation schedules, including asset additions, dispositions, bonus depreciation, Section 179, and remaining depreciable basis

Read operating agreements and partnership agreements to identify ownership percentages, capital account provisions, profit and loss allocations, and special allocation language

Review purchase and sale contracts, identify purchase price allocation, closing statements, and settlement documents to basis, transaction costs, and timing

Abstract key terms from loan documents, leases, and related-party agreements as they aﬀect basis, at-risk amounts, and deductibility

Track down missing documents and follow up with clients and internal team members until the file is complete

Analysis and workpaper preparation

Build and maintain standardized tax planning workpapers and data-gathering templates

Prepare current-year income projections and multi-entity roll-ups from interim financial data

Calculate and document basis, at-risk, and passive activity information at the entity and

owner level

Tie out source documents to workpapers so every number in a planning deliverable is traceable to support

Flag inconsistencies, unusual items, and open questions for the tax strategist rather than making assumptions

Assist in preparing cost segregation and depreciation-related analyses



Tax support and firm workflow

Assist with tax return preparation support, quality-control checklists, and review comment clearing as needed

title: Sales & Leasing Coordinator

This role is focused on following up with warm leads, coordinating salon suite tours, keeping prospects engaged, and making sure no lead falls through the cracks.



You will work behind the scenes with marketing and local leasing agents to create a smooth experience for stylists who are interested in renting a salon suite.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Pre-Tour Follow-Up & Coordination

~ Contact prospects within 24 hours after a tour is booked

Lead Follow-Up & Nurturing

~ Make sure every prospect has a clear next step

Post-Tour Follow-Up

~ Send thank-you and recap messages after tours

~ Answer basic questions and provide helpful information

~ Escalate more complex questions to the appropriate local leasing agent

~ Keep prospects engaged throughout the leasing process



CRM & Sales Administration

~ Maintain accurate and up-to-date CRM records

~ Track prospect status such as tour scheduled, showed, no-show, applied, and signed

~ Add clear notes and next-action dates for every assigned prospect

~ Coordinate with local leasing agents regarding missing forms, documents, photos, or other requirements

~ Help ensure leads across multiple U.S. locations are consistently followed up with



IMPORTANT: This is not a cold-calling or cold-prospecting role. You will primarily work with warm leads and prospects who have already expressed interest in a salon suite.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



~ Excellent written and spoken English

~ Warm, friendly, and professional communication style

~ At least 1 year of experience in customer support, sales administration, appointment setting, leasing coordination, or a similar role

~ Strong attention to detail and excellent follow-through

~ Highly organized and comfortable managing multiple prospects and follow-up dates

~ Comfortable using CRM systems and keeping detailed notes

~ Reliable with schedules, deadlines, and promised follow-ups

~ Comfortable communicating through phone, text,
, and messaging platforms

~ Able to work independently in a remote environment

~ Someone who enjoys checklists, processes, and making sure nothing gets missed



YOU'LL BE A GREAT FIT IF...



~ You are naturally organized and don't need constant reminders

~ You take ownership when you tell a prospect you'll follow up on a certain date

~ You are comfortable talking with people and building rapport

~ You enjoy supporting a sales team without needing to be the person making every sale

~ You pay attention to small details that can make a prospect's experience feel more professional

~ You understand that consistent follow-up can make a big difference in appointments and conversions



SUCCESS IN THIS ROLE



Your work will directly support:



~ Higher tour show rates

~ Consistent pre-tour and post-tour follow-up

~ Better lead organization and CRM accuracy

~ More completed applications and leases

~ A smoother experience for prospects from their first inquiry through the leasing process



Schedule: 9-5 CST



Compensation

Base: 650–800 USD/month.

Performance bonus:

Monthly quality bonus ($50–100) if:

~ 95%+ of promised follow‑ups are on time, and

~ Show rate across your locations beats last month’s baseline.



HOW TO APPLY



Please submit the following:



~ Updated CV/Resume

~ 1–2 minute Vocaroo voice recording introducing yourself and briefly discussing your relevant experience

Please make sure your Vocaroo link & link to CV is accessible.



We are looking for someone who is dependable, detail-oriented, proactive, and genuinely enjoys helping people. If you're the type of person who remembers the follow-up, keeps the CRM organized, and makes sure every prospect feels taken care of, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Real Estate Lead Manager

REQUIREMENTS

Fluent in English, both spoken and written

Previous experience in real estate, inbound sales, lead qualification, customer service, appointment setting, or another phone-based role

Strong verbal communication and active listening skills

Comfortable speaking with homeowners and handling inbound calls

Comfortable asking direct questions and qualifying prospects

Strong attention to detail and accurate CRM documentation

Organized, reliable, and self-motivated

Coachable and willing to follow established processes and scripts

Able to work independently in a remote environment

Stable internet connection and reliable computer/headset setup

COMPENSATION & INCENTIVES

WORKING HOURS



Monday–Friday

9:00 AM–6:00 PM Eastern Time (ET)

title: Experienced Video Editors (Multiple Hires)
description:
I help run a training program that teaches beginners how to build YouTube Channels. Part of this training is I encourage our members to outsource some or all of the skilled tasks required, particularly the video creation.



I am looking for experienced video editors who can help our members build these channels.



A few may want compilation videos, but a vast majority will be doing AI videos. Typically around 8 to 10 minute long form videos. If you only do vertical shorts this is not for you. 



Here is how the process will work. Should you be accepted, I will add you to my preferred list of Video Editors available for hire.



This list will include your profile link here on Onlinejobs along with any information you wish to share with me about yourself.



My members will reach out to you via WhatsApp or
. The interview process should be brief as they will know that you have already been pre-screened by me.



Should they feel comfortable with you at this point they will most likely ask you to do a paid test. The test will involve them giving you their first script and asking you to create a video doing the first few minutes of it. Should they like what they see they will hire you.



It is important to understand you will be working with them, not me. Also most will be inexperienced in working with Assistants so some patience and understanding may be needed on your part. I will not step in and get involved in this business arrangement unless there is a problem.



Tasks you will be asked to do will range from only making the video and sending it to them, to full service doing everything from doing thumbnails, uploading into their channel, analytic review, etc. It is up to you to d
 how much you feel comfortable taking on and setting those expectations with my members.



We provide all members with AI prompts that will generate the scripts for them. I will handle the SEO of the videos up until the point that they are eligible to apply for YPP. At that point the member is on their own and most likely turn to you for continued support unless you do not provide that type of service. 



In most cases they will be asking you to do two to three videos a week.



The big advantage for you here is that my members will be coming to you. If your work is good and your prices are reasonable there will be no need for you to continue job hunting. You will get all the work you can handle. I can pretty much guarantee that. We have dozens of active members right now, and we are scaling up our operation.



There are just a few do’s and don’ts I need to point out. 

MAKE SURE YOU READ AND UNDERSTAND THIS PART



You MUST create good, high-quality videos. NO AI SLOP! All content must be watermark free and good high quality voice over. If you use ElevenLabs, you need to be using voices offered at Creator level membership or higher. YouTube will no longer monetize channels with low-quality, low-effort videos. If I start getting reports that you are putting out subpar work, you will be removed from my list.



You MUST HAVE YOUR OWN APPS TO DO THE JOB. Do NOT ask my members to pay for your tools. Asking them to cover the cost of points used in your app is fine, but not the monthly cost of the app. With the amount of work you will get from this you can just charge an extra two or three dollars a video, and that should more than cover the monthly subscription fee.



Do not ask members to pay for videos upfront. I understand some of the risk you take on when doing this, but I can assure you this should not happen with my members. If they do not pay, you can contact me, and I will speak to them. If it is true and they have no legitimate reason for not paying you, they will be kicked out of our program that they paid a lot of money for.



If a member reaches out to you, I do ask that you ALWAYS respond. Even if it is to tell them you are not taking on any new clients at this time. If you want to be taken off my list for a while, that is fine. Just reach out and let me know, and I can do that for you. When you want to be back on, then again, let me know, and I will put you back on. However, if I continually get reports from my members that they reached out to you and got no response, I will remove you from my list and you will get no further referrals from me.



***** MOST IMPORTANT****

As far as pricing is concerned, you have to understand and read the room of who you are working with. 



I know from other clients you may have asked $80 to $100 or more for a video and got it.  For a business owner who is looking for maybe two or three videos a month and wants to use it to increase their exposure on social media and can get thousands of dollars of increased revenue from it, that price is very reasonable and acceptable. 



However, these are beginning YouTubers. They are going to want two or three videos a week, and it is going to be months of pouring money into this before they see any return on investment at all.   



So asking for $100/video is not going to work. You will get zero takers at that price. 



Two factors you need to consider. One the quantity of videos you will be asked to make will be far greater than someone looking for a few videos to promote their business or product. 



Secondly, and most importantly, If you come in at under $60 a video, perhaps even $40, I can very much assure you will be getting at least three to five new clients every month. That is a conservative estimate. 



STILL INTERESTED? If so, read on.



If this is something you want to jump into then here is what you need to do



Reply to this job post within the Onlinejobs portal. Do NOT
 me directly outside of onlinejobs. If you do so I will not respond.



In the subject line include the word “SEAL”



In the first line of your response I want to see you say that you have read, understand, and agree to all the conditions I have mentioned in this post.  



Send to me everything you would like included in my referral directory. This can be as much or as little as you like. Whatever you put will, for the most part, be cut and pasted into my directory. Do NOT include your contact information in this.



My advice to get the most inquiries would be to include as much as the following as you can:



Years of experience as a video editor

What types of videos you specialize in

What tools do you use

Links to your portfolio

Links to any work you have done on YouTube or other sites.

What skill sets you have beyond video editing that might be of interest

Other tasks you are willing to assist in running a YouTube channel.

Your price range

Anything else you feel would be helpful to know about you.



I will say that including any additional tasks and price range are the things that will give you the best results. The price range can come with the caveat that it depends on the scope of your project. Also, if it is for Video only. You can d
 what additional tasks will be extra.



Once you respond, I may have some additional questions for you. The more you include in your initial response the faster I can get you on my referral list. 



If you have any questions for me, feel free to ask before applying.



Please give me time to respond. It may be several days. I am very busy with a lot on my plate, and I anticipate getting a lot of inquiries for this. So be patient, please.

title: Graphic Designer — Paid Ads & eCommerce Creative

About ARDANT



ARDANT is a premium fine jewellery brand in a fast-growth phase. As we scale, the standard of everything a customer sees has to rise with us — every ad, every page, every asset should feel considered, elevated, and unmistakably ARDANT.



Paid advertising is one of our most important growth levers, and our creative carries a dual responsibility: to perform and to protect the premium feel of the brand. We are looking for an experienced designer who delivers high-performing static ad creative and has the craft and taste to work across the wider eCommerce experience.



The role in one line

Direction and copy are provided. Your responsibility is to translate a brief into refined, high-performing design: how the work looks, and how well it converts.

You will edit e-commerce video ads for Meta from briefs, scripts, references and raw assets. You will work closely with creative strategists and pod leads, submit work for internal QA, respond to feedback and keep improving your output over time.



This role is not for someone who needs to be chased through every step. We want an editor who can understand a brief, make strong creative decisions, check their own work and deliver reliably.



WHAT YOU’LL DO



- Edit e-commerce video ads for Meta, generally using UGC, product footage, stock, screen recordings, founder content, AI-generated assets and b-roll

- Build strong opening hooks and produce thoughtful variations from winning creative

- Create clear, well-paced edits with effective captions, text overlays, sound design, music and light motion graphics

- Follow the brief and reference closely while adapting the edit to the product, audience and brand

- Make sure visuals, voiceover, captions, claims, offers, product details and brand assets all match the brief

- Submit organised work through our production workflow and meet agreed deadlines

- Apply QA feedback accurately rather than repeating the same mistakes

WHO WE WANT



We want operators, not talkers.

title: $500/Month — Wedding Video Editor | Paid Training, Constant Work, Weekly Pay | Long-Term
description:
We are a wedding-video business looking for reliable Adobe Premiere Pro editors who want a long-term position and a steady flow of paid work.



THE JOB OFFER



• Ongoing wedding-video editing in small, clearly defined assignments

• Weekly payment through PayPal for approved work

• An average of US$500 per month

• A clear path from a short skills assessment to paid training and then regular paid work with our team



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



• Working knowledge of Adobe Premiere Pro

• A Windows PC suitable for running Adobe Premiere Pro; this workflow is PC-based

• Ability to receive payments through PayPal

• Careful attention to instructions and detail

• Fast, dependable delivery and responsive communication

• Conversational English

• Availability Monday–Friday, 09:00–14:00 GMT+3, during training. After training, you can work whenever you like, as long as you meet all deadlines.

• Willingness to ask questions and report progress



Previous wedding or multicamera editing experience is welcome, but it is not required. Some of our best editors joined us without any wedding-editing experience.



STEP 1: SHORT SKILLS ASSESSMENT



Shortlisted candidates complete a brief paid editing assessment before training, for which you will be paid. The assessment uses real wedding footage from a project that was completed and delivered several years ago. You will not send us the Adobe Premiere Pro project file. You will submit only timeline screenshots and low-quality video renders so we can review the timing of your cuts, the beats, and which shots you selected—nothing more. The assessment consists of an already synced five-minute multicam timeline and a 30-second reception timeline and should take approximately 10 minutes of editing time if you have some experience editing in Adobe Premiere Pro. It is used to confirm that you can understand the workflow, follow instructions accurately, communicate well, and deliver on time.



STEP 2: PAID TRAINING



Candidates who pass the test enter paid training. You receive access to our learning platform, training videos, tutorials, and guidance from a personal tutor during the training hours above. Training continues until you reach the editing standard required for ongoing work. The training rate and milestones will be confirmed before training begins.



ONGOING PAID WORK AND CONTINUED TRAINING



Once you complete the initial training, you will begin receiving a constant flow of paid wedding-video assignments with synced material and clear instructions. Our syncers handle synchronization, our ML system supplies the preprocessed multicam, you vet the result, and our QC team reviews the complete multicam.



The learning does not stop when the paid work begins. Your real assignments will go hand in hand with continued training as you learn every part of our wedding-video workflow. You will progress step by step through the different types of edits until you reach the highest level: creating complete wedding highlights.



We are looking for editors who want to stay, improve, take on more responsibility, and become long-term members of our team.



HOW TO APPLY



1. Start your application with the word CEREMONY so we know you read the full post.

2. Include a 30-second audio introduction. This is required so we can assess your spoken English.

3. Confirm that you work on a Windows PC.

4. Confirm that you can receive payments through PayPal.

5. Confirm that you can be available Monday–Friday, 09:00–14:00 GMT+3, during paid training.

6. If you have edited wedding videos before, you are welcome to include one link to your best wedding highlight. This is optional; previous wedding-editing experience is not required.

Do you take pride in meeting every single deadline, updating team trackers, and communicating project statuses proactively without needing hand-holding?



We are looking for a reliable, resourceful YouTube Video Editor & Content Repurposing Specialist to take ownership of post-production across our two YouTube channels. Your primary objective will be executing our growth strategy: updating, polishing, and repurposing top-performing legacy content alongside fresh releases to re-engage our massive audience.



ABOUT US



Balance Foot & Ankle is a doctor-owned podiatry practice in Michigan, USA. Our founder, Dr. Tom Biernacki, is a board-certified surgeon who educates millions of viewers worldwide on foot and ankle health. We run a flagship medical YouTube channel with over 900,000 subscribers, as well as a second growing channel. We work as a tight-knit virtual team to expand our global reach.



PRIMARY FOCUS: REPURPOSING TOP-PERFORMING LEGACY CONTENT

We have hundreds of past videos that still rank well on YouTube. A major part of your role will be refining, updating, and re-releasing these videos to boost viewer retention and channel growth.



Your Content Repurposing Workflow:



Pacing & Trimming: Cut out fluff, slow sections, and repetitive parts to tighten pacing and keep viewers hooked.

Visual Upgrades: Replace outdated intros, low-resolution graphics, and old slides with modern B-roll, dynamic zooms, animations, and high-quality visual overlays.

Audio Enhancement: Polish raw/older audio using modern tools (denoise, normalize, EQ) for crisp, professional audio clarity.

Optimized Packaging: Prepare fully edited files for upload with new titles, updated graphics, and refreshed metadata.

Short-Form Extraction: Extract 5–10 viral Short clips (30–60s) from long-form legacy videos with dynamic captions and sound hooks.

Team Tracking & Collaboration: Maintain accurate status updates in group collaboration trackers (Google Sheets, 
, & Trello) so the team always knows project statuses.



Example Workflow: Take a 20-minute "Heel Spur" video from 2022  Trim fluff and re-edit to a punchy 12 minutes  Enhance audio & add updated visuals/commentary  Package and upload as an updated guide.



WEEKLY DELIVERABLES & RESPONSIBILITIES

3 Long-Form Videos/Week: Edit and repurpose 8–15 minute videos across both channels.

5–10 Shorts/Reels per Week: Extract and craft engaging vertical shorts with bold captions, fast cuts, and strong hooks.

Strict Progress Tracking: Update all production trackers daily, flagging any potential bottlenecks before deadlines are reached.



WHAT GREAT LOOKS LIKE

100% On-Time Delivery: Deadlines are non-negotiable. Videos are fully checked, rendered, and uploaded on schedule.

Proactive Communication: You keep the team informed on project progress daily and update shared trackers without prompt.

Self-Motivated & Resourceful: You independently find relevant B-roll, graphic assets, and audio fixes without needing step-by-step instructions.

Measurable Audience Growth: Your pacing edits, hooks, and thumbnail redesigns directly translate to higher retention curves and subscriber growth.



TOOLS

Editing & Audio: Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Final Cut Pro + audio plugins (denoise, EQ)

Graphics & Thumbnails: Adobe Photoshop, After Effects, Canva

Operations & Communication: Google Workspace, Trello, 
, Production Tracking Sheets

Time Tracking: Hubstaff



WHAT YOU BRING

• 3+ years of video editing experience, preferably for YouTube, educational, or health/medical content.

• Proven track record in content repurposing (demonstrating how you transformed long/footage into engaging final cuts).

• Strong portfolio showcasing long-form YouTube edits and vertical Shorts/Reels.

• Fluent English (written/verbal) for clear team updates and accurate text captioning.

• Reliable high-speed internet, backup power/connection, and a dedicated workspace.



SCHEDULE & PAY

Full-Time: 40 hours per week.

Salary: $6.50 – 8.50perhour (1,126 – $1,473 USD/month), depending on portfolio quality, speed, and track record.

Long-Term Role: Direct-hire position with potential for performance bonuses and long-term pay growth. Editing software subscription assistance provided.



HOW TO APPLY (Please follow every step)

Applications missing any step will not be reviewed.

1. Start your application title or opening line with the exact keyword: "Repurpose Pro".

2. Submit Your Portfolio: Provide direct links to long-form YouTube videos you have edited/repurposed and vertical Shorts you created.

3. Repurposing Mini-Challenge: Describe in 3–4 sentences how you would approach taking a 20-minute video recorded 3 years ago and updating it into a modern, high-retention 10-minute video.

4. Communication & Workflow Test: Briefly explain how you manage project deadlines and keep team collaboration trackers up to date.

5. Speed Test & Rate: Include a link to a recent internet speed test (speedtest.net) and state your expected hourly rate within our range (6.5–8.5/hr).

title: Long & Short-Form Video Editor
description:
About the Role



We are a fast-growing wellness brand rethinking the traditional protein bar — an all-natural, whole-food protein bar using clean, recognizable ingredients. As the brand expands across retail, our founders are documenting the behind-the-scenes journey of building the business — from travelling across the US and supporting retail launches to demos, events, and everyday startup life.



We're looking for a Long & Short-Form Video Editor to turn that raw footage into engaging, story-driven content. This role will primarily focus on editing long-form YouTube-style content, supported by short-form edits for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and the founders' personal social channels.



You'll receive raw footage from the founders and be responsible for turning it into polished, engaging content that captures the personality, energy, and reality of building a fast-growing consumer brand. We're looking for someone who is more than a technical editor — you should understand storytelling, pacing, humour, hooks, and retention, and be able to identify the moments within hours of footage that are actually worth watching.



Work Structure & Requirements



Location: Remote / Virtual

Schedule: Part-time (20 hours per week)

Time Zone: EST business hours

Compensation: 8 USD per hour

Key Responsibilities



1. Long-Form Video Editing



Edit raw founder footage into engaging YouTube-style episodes, typically around 15–25 minutes

Review several hours of raw footage and identify the strongest moments, storylines, and narrative arcs

Turn loosely structured footage into cohesive, entertaining stories

Cut unnecessary material while maintaining natural pacing and personality

Add music, sound effects, text, graphics, subtitles, and other elements where appropriate

Handle basic colour correction, audio cleanup, and overall visual consistency

Create strong openings and hooks that encourage viewers to continue watching

Incorporate B-roll and supporting footage to strengthen storytelling

Manage revisions and deliver polished final edits on schedule

2. Short-Form Content



Turn long-form footage and standalone clips into TikToks, Instagram Reels, and other vertical content

Identify short moments that can work independently as compelling social content

Edit clips with strong hooks, captions, pacing, and platform-native formatting

Create content for both the brand and the founders' personal accounts

Develop teasers and cutdowns that help drive audiences toward longer YouTube content

Repurpose existing footage efficiently to maximise the value of each shoot

3. Content & Editing Workflow



Organise raw footage, project files, and completed assets in a clear and repeatable system

Maintain consistent editing styles, fonts, graphics, and visual treatments

Work closely with the founders to understand their preferred style and continuously refine it

Manage multiple videos at different stages of the editing process

Proactively suggest opportunities to turn existing footage into additional content

Stay current with editing styles and content trends across YouTube, TikTok, and Instagram

Required Skills & Experience



Experience: 3+ years of professional video editing experience

Portfolio: Strong portfolio demonstrating both long-form and short-form editing; experience editing YouTube, documentary-style, vlog, founder-led, or behind-the-scenes content

Storytelling: Strong understanding of storytelling, pacing, and audience retention; ability to take several hours of raw footage and independently determine what should make the final cut

Short-Form: Excellent short-form editing instincts for TikTok and Instagram Reels

Technical: Proficiency with Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar professional editing software; comfortable with captions, motion graphics, sound design, and basic colour correction

Organisation: Highly organised and able to manage large volumes of footage

Communication: Excellent written and spoken English; able to work independently with limited direction

Bonus: Experience editing content for CPG, food, wellness, fitness, or lifestyle brands; experience editing founder-led YouTube series or startup/build-in-public content; basic motion graphics or After Effects experience; YouTube thumbnail design; familiarity with YouTube retention analytics; experience repurposing long-form content into multiple short-form assets



To Apply:

Kindly send your resume, portfolio and introduction video

title: Short-Form Video Editor / Content Tastemaker (US Humor, Meme-Fluent) – Instagram Reels
description:
About us: We run several fast-growing Instagram accounts for a fitness and lifestyle creator. Together they get millions of reel views a month. We already have a team of editors for volume. This hire is for taste: someone who knows meme culture and spots new formats before they peak.



What you'll do:

- Turn raw footage of the creator into Reels and Trial Reels that feel native to US internet culture

- Spot trends, sounds and meme formats early and adapt them before they peak

- Write short, punchy on-screen captions and hooks in natural American English (POV, ironic, absurdist, relatable)

- Make new formats for the other editors to copy, and give feedback on their edits

- Edit in CapCut (or better)



You're a fit if:

- You're chronically online. You know what's funny on TikTok, IG and Twitter/X this week, not last year

- You understand American humor, irony and slang, and your captions don't read as translated

- You have an eye for pacing, first-second hooks and music choice

- You're comfortable working with a lifestyle creator's content (fitness, fashion, swimwear)

- You have a stable internet connection



Nice to have:

- Clean face and skin retouching without default presets



Pay and benefits:

- Training starts at $400/mo and goes up quickly based on skill and experience

- Bi-weekly payment

- Flexible schedule: work whenever you want, as long as it's done on time with 40 hours a week

- Flexible time off if requested



APPLICATION TEST (required, about 30 minutes)



Part 1 - Rank these 5 reels from most viral to least viral, based on how you think a US audience reacted:



Reel A: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Cujv2eZop_2Q56gApvJbsi160IxYeWYm/view

Reel B: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1CNB5c-DK70V1xLlVcbEMnIN8M4gltMXn/view

Reel C: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1wVo6F_1BJ73lPbuVQKRhUQjkM1wFG66-/view

Reel D: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1wV-5d4gUu0x2RH_qZ9GFJ-St_8elEtwY/view

Reel E: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1TVfI-AElFboFHLwy3A9Gbkyo8a7LJcrD/view



Write your ranking as letters from best to worst (for example: C, A, E, B, D), with one sentence for each on why you put it there. There's a right answer, since we know how each one performed. Your reasoning counts as much as the order.



Part 2 - Write captions. For each of these 2 raw clips, type 3 on-screen caption or hook options in your message (6 total):



Clip 1: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Hcy6rxdAjJ3Lp0NRfUfIFTH3sXL2Ika-/view

Clip 2: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1VBSoom8d3iNZlhkYlmReoQwjtpNGYEdU/view



Optional bonus: edit one clip into a meme format and send the link. The bonus does not replace the 6 typed captions.



Part 3 - Send us 3 memes you find funny right now that would be good references for this creator. Send links (TikTok, Instagram, X or YouTube) to memes posted in the last 30 days. For each one, write one sentence on how you'd adapt it for a fitness and lifestyle creator.



HOW TO APPLY

1. The first line of your message must be MEME LORD (putting it only in the subject line doesn't count)

2. Send 5+ links to short-form videos you made. Public TikTok or Instagram links are best. If you send Drive files, add a screenshot of the views or insights

3. Put your answers to Parts 1, 2 and 3 in the message itself



We don't review applications that skip any of these steps.

title: Operations Coordinator / Sales Operations Support
description:
About the Role

We are a fast-growing personal care and wellness brand with a growing global retail footprint across Australia, the USA, Canada, the UK, Saudi Arabia, and other international markets. We're looking for a highly organised and detail-oriented Operations Coordinator / Sales Operations Support to sit at the centre of Sales, Supply Chain, logistics, customers, and 3PL partners.

The role will focus primarily on the day-to-day execution of customer orders across international markets — ensuring orders are entered correctly, warehouse requirements are met, delivery issues are resolved, and the Sales team has the information and administrative support needed to service customers effectively.



Work Structure & Requirements

Location: Remote / Virtual

Schedule: Full-time

Time Zone: AEST/NZST

Compensation: 10 USD per hour



Key Responsibilities

1. Order Management & Customer Fulfilment

Manage customer orders from receipt through warehouse release, dispatch, delivery, and proof of delivery

Process and review orders received through SPS Commerce, EDI, and other customer channels

Enter and maintain orders accurately within Unleashed and relevant internal systems

Ensure customer-specific requirements, documentation, pricing, SKUs, quantities, and delivery details are correct

Maintain visibility of open orders and proactively flag delays, shortages, or fulfilment risks

2. 3PL & Logistics Coordination

Coordinate across multiple 3PL partners and help support the launch of additional international warehouse locations

Follow up on lost stock, shortages, missing deliveries, warehouse errors, and other fulfilment issues

Maintain stock-on-hand reporting and support inventory visibility across regional warehouses

Work with 3PLs and internal teams to drive operational issues through to resolution

3. Sales Operations Support

Support the Sales team with customer setup, new line forms, account opening documentation, and retailer onboarding

Complete detailed retailer and distributor forms, including large and complex account documentation

Maintain accurate customer master data, pricing, SKUs, UPCs/EANs, case configurations, and freight terms

Provide Sales with accurate inventory, order, and delivery information for customer meetings and launches

Support new market, retailer, and distributor launches from an operational perspective

4. Customer & Administrative Support

Help resolve customer complaints, order issues, and delivery discrepancies

Maintain accurate internal trackers, reports, and documentation

Support operational communication between Sales, Supply Chain, Finance, customers, and logistics partners

Assist with ad hoc reporting and operational analysis as required

Required Skills & Experience

Experience: 3+ years in CPG operations, sales operations, logistics, customer fulfilment, or order management

International Operations: Strong experience working with 3PLs, retailers, distributors, and international customer accounts across multiple markets

Order Management Systems: Experience with EDI, SPS Commerce, or similar order management platforms; experience with Unleashed or a similar ERP/inventory management system is strongly preferred

Excel: Advanced Excel skills are essential — confident working with complex spreadsheets and customer documentation

Retailer Documentation: Comfortable completing detailed retailer setup forms, new line forms, and operational documentation

Communication: Strong written and spoken English; strong numerical ability and exceptional attention to detail

AI Tools: Comfortable using AI tools to improve efficiency, reporting, and administrative workflows

Profile: Highly organised, proactive, and able to manage multiple markets and stakeholders simultaneously; strong problem-solving skills with the ability to resolve issues rather than simply escalate them; operates confidently in a high-volume environment and keeps a close eye on detail across orders, stock, documentation, and customer requirements



To Apply:

Kindly send your resume and introduction video (candidates who have submitted this will be prioritized)

title: Performance-Based DTC Video Editor
description:
About the Role



We’re looking for a Performance-Based DTC Video Editor who understands that great advertising creative is about more than making a video look good.



You’ll be creating direct-response video ads for DTC/e-commerce brands, with a strong focus on hooks, retention, storytelling, conversion, and measurable performance.



You’ll work with raw footage, UGC, AI-generated assets, voiceovers, B-roll, and other creative assets to produce high-performing ads for platforms like Meta/Facebook and Instagram.



This role is ideal for an editor who thinks like a marketer — someone who understands why an ad works, what makes people stop scrolling, and how creative can be improved based on performance data.



Responsibilities



•  Performance Video Editing

•  Edit high-performing short-form video ads for DTC and e-commerce brands

•  Create direct-response creatives designed to generate conversions

• Build strong hooks that capture attention within the first few seconds

• Maintain pacing, storytelling, and retention throughout each video

• Use B-roll, UGC, graphics, captions, sound design, and other assets to strengthen the creative

• Adapt existing concepts and winning creatives into new variations

• Produce multiple creative variations for testing and optimization



Creative Testing & Optimization



• Create variations of hooks, angles, openings, CTAs, and creative structures

• Analyze creative performance and apply learnings to future edits

• Work with creative strategists to develop and improve advertising concepts

• Identify opportunities to improve retention, engagement, and conversion

• Iterate quickly based on performance data and creative feedback

• Understand the difference between content that looks good and content that actually performs



DTC & Direct-Response Creative



• Create advertising content specifically for DTC/e-commerce audiences

• Understand customer psychology and purchase intent

• Translate marketing angles and offers into compelling video creatives

• Use proven direct-response principles in editing and storytelling

• Study winning ads and identify the creative elements that contribute to their performance

• Stay aware of current trends in performance creative and paid social advertising

• AI & Creative Tools

• Work with AI-generated video, images, voiceovers, and avatar content

• Use AI-powered creative tools to increase production speed and output

• Combine AI-generated assets with traditional editing techniques to create natural and engaging ads

• Continuously test new tools and workflows that can improve creative production

• Maintain quality and authenticity when working with AI-generated content



Collaboration & Production



• Work closely with creative strategists, marketers, and other editors

• Follow creative briefs while contributing your own creative ideas

• Manage multiple projects and deadlines in a fast-paced environment

• Communicate clearly and respond quickly to creative feedback

• Maintain organized project files and efficient editing workflows



Requirements

• 2+ years of professional video editing experience

• Proven experience creating DTC/e-commerce or direct-response advertising creatives

• Strong portfolio of performance-based video ads

• Experience creating content for Meta/Facebook and Instagram advertising

• Strong understanding of hooks, retention, pacing, storytelling, and CTAs

• Ability to create multiple creative variations for testing

• Strong understanding of what makes short-form advertising content perform

• Proficiency in Premiere Pro, CapCut, Final Cut Pro, or similar editing software

• Strong attention to detail and ability to work quickly without sacrificing quality

• Ability to take creative feedback and implement revisions quickly

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-volume creative environment



Preferred Qualifications



• Experience working with DTC/e-commerce brands

• Experience with performance marketing and direct-response advertising

• Experience editing UGC ads

• Experience working with Meta ad campaigns

• Understanding of creative performance metrics

• Experience with supplements, health, wellness, beauty, or other consumer products

• Experience with AI video, voice, avatar, or image-generation tools

• Motion graphics and animation experience

• Experience working with creative testing frameworks



Performance Bonuses

• This role offers a $2,000+ monthly retainer plus performance-based bonuses.

• Performance bonuses are tied to agreed creative and business performance targets. The specific bonus structure and criteria will be explained during the hiring process.



What Success Looks Like



Success in this role isn’t simply producing more videos.



It’s producing better-performing creative.



You’ll be expected to consistently create ads that capture attention, hold viewer retention, communicate the offer clearly, and drive measurable results.



The goal is to become an editor who understands the business impact behind the creative — not just the editing itself.

title: Remote Procurement Invoice Control Assistant
description:
# Remote Procurement Invoice Control Assistant (m/f/d)



**Location:** Remote  

**Employment Type:** Full-time  

**Department:** Procurement / Operations



## #BEcomeMAXX



You are highly organized, detail-oriented and comfortable working with invoices, purchase orders and supplier data?



As our **Remote Procurement Invoice Control Assistant**, you support our Procurement team by ensuring that supplier invoices are accurate, complete and aligned with purchase orders, agreed prices and delivered quantities.



You act as an important control point between **Procurement, Finance, Logistics and our suppliers**, helping us identify discrepancies early and keep our purchasing processes clean, transparent and efficient.



## Your Responsibilities



### Invoice & Purchase Order Control



- Review supplier invoices against purchase orders, order confirmations and agreed purchasing conditions

- Verify prices, quantities, discounts, freight charges and other invoice components

- Identify discrepancies between invoices, purchase orders and deliveries

- Check that invoice information and supporting documents are complete and correct

- Maintain a clear overview of open invoice discrepancies and unresolved cases



### Supplier & Internal Coordination



- Clarify invoice discrepancies with suppliers and internal Procurement colleagues

- Follow up on missing documents, credit notes and invoice corrections

- Coordinate with Finance / Accounts Payable regarding blocked or unclear invoices

- Support Procurement in resolving price, quantity and delivery-related differences

- Document communication and status updates in a structured and traceable way



### Data & Administration



- Maintain accurate purchasing and invoice-related data in our systems

- Update purchase orders, supplier information and relevant trackers where required

- Prepare simple reports on open discrepancies, pending credit notes and recurring supplier issues

- Support the Procurement team with administrative tasks and documentation

- Ensure all relevant documents are properly filed and easy to retrieve



## What You Bring



- Previous experience in **Procurement, Purchasing Administration, Invoice Control, Accounts Payable or Finance Administration**

- Good understanding of invoices, purchase orders and basic purchasing processes

- Strong attention to detail and confidence working with numbers

- Very structured and reliable way of working

- Ability to identify discrepancies and follow cases through until resolution

- Good Excel / Microsoft Office skills

- Experience with ERP systems is an advantage

- Strong written English skills; German is an advantage

- Comfortable working independently in a remote environment



## What Is Important to Us



- **Accuracy:** You notice when numbers, quantities or prices do not match

- **Ownership:** You do not only identify discrepancies — you actively follow up until they are resolved

- **Structure:** You keep a clear overview even when several cases are open at the same time

- **Communication:** You communicate professionally and clearly with suppliers and internal teams

- **Reliability:** Procurement and Finance can depend on the information you provide



## Your Impact



Your work helps us to:



- avoid incorrect supplier payments

- identify purchasing discrepancies early

- improve invoice processing speed

- reduce unnecessary costs and duplicate payments

- maintain reliable supplier and purchasing data

- create better transparency between Procurement, Logistics and Finance



## Ready to perform?



Become part of IronMaxx and help us build a more accurate, efficient and scalable Procurement operation.



**#BEcomeMAXX**

We are looking for a reliable Short Form Video Editor to join our fitness coaching business on a part-time, ongoing basis.

The priority is speed, consistency and following our editing style.

* S-Tier / ranking videos

* Simple talking-head videos

* Basic captions and on-screen text

* Simple cuts to remove pauses and mistakes

title: Senior Fashion Product Researcher & Shopify Product Liste
description:
# Senior Fashion Product Researcher & Shopify Product Lister



We are looking for a highly experienced **Fashion Product Researcher & Shopify Product Lister** to help research, select and list products for our international fashion e-commerce stores.



This is a senior position. It is not suitable for beginners, general virtual assistants or candidates who have only completed basic Shopify product uploads.



## Mandatory Experience Requirement



You must have previous professional experience working with one or more **fashion e-commerce stores generating at least $5,000 in daily revenue**.



This is a mandatory requirement, not a preference.



You must be able to demonstrate:



\- Which fashion stores you worked with  

\- How much daily or monthly revenue these stores generated  

\- Which countries and markets the stores operated in  

\- How long you worked with each store  

\- What your personal responsibilities were  

\- How many products you researched and listed  

\- Which research methods and tools you used  

\- Which results your product selections achieved  



You must be prepared to provide anonymized screenshots, reports, examples, a Loom video or a live screenshare.



If you worked as part of a larger team, you must clearly explain which work you personally performed. Do not claim the total results of a store or agency as your own.



Confidential information may be hidden, but your experience must still be verifiable.



**If you do not have demonstrable experience with fashion stores generating at least $5,000 per day, please do not apply.**



## About the Position



You will be responsible for the complete process from product-category research to creating finished Shopify product listings.



You will not randomly import products from competitors or suppliers. Every product recommendation must be supported by search demand, trend data, competitor evidence, supplier information, pricing and expected margins.



Approved products must then be converted into complete, unique and Google Shopping-compliant Shopify listings.



## Product Research Responsibilities



\- Analyse the existing product range of each fashion store  

\- Identify missing and underrepresented fashion categories  

\- Research detailed fashion categories and subcategories  

\- Use Google Keyword Planner to verify search demand  

\- Use Google Trends to analyse seasonal and long-term demand  

\- Recognize the difference between seasonal and evergreen categories  

\- Identify product categories before their demand begins to peak  

\- Plan product launches several weeks or months in advance  

\- Analyse successful fashion competitors and their bestselling categories  

\- Find concrete products within approved categories  

\- Use competitor stores, Google Shopping, Meta Ads Library and other relevant sources  

\- Research suitable suppliers for selected products  

\- Verify purchasing prices, shipping costs and delivery times  

\- Compare products with trustworthy fashion competitors  

\- Calculate possible selling prices and profit margins  

\- Review available sizes, colours and variants  

\- Identify potential quality, sizing, compliance and return risks  

\- Provide screenshots, links and evidence for every recommendation  

\- Maintain organized lists of approved, rejected and previously researched products  



## Shopify Product Listing Responsibilities



\- Create complete Shopify listings for approved fashion products  

\- Write unique, keyword-focused product titles  

\- Include relevant fashion keywords without keyword stuffing  

\- Write clear, persuasive and original product descriptions  

\- Use AI to improve titles, descriptions and listing quality  

\- Manually review and correct all AI-generated content  

\- Select and organize high-quality product images  

\- Edit or replace unsuitable supplier images when needed  

\- Remove watermarks, logos, text and supplier information  

\- Add and verify all sizes, colours and variants  

\- Check that images and variants match correctly  

\- Set accurate prices and comparison prices  

\- Complete product categories, product types, vendors, collections and tags  

\- Write SEO titles and meta descriptions  

\- Complete all relevant Google Shopping attributes  

\- Ensure that the product URL matches the final product title  

\- Upload all products to Shopify as drafts  

\- Complete a final quality-control checklist before requesting approval  



Products must never be published without approval.



## Research Standards



Every product recommendation must include:



\- Product category  

\- Search volume or demand information  

\- Trend direction  

\- Seasonal timing  

\- Recommended launch period  

\- Competitor examples  

\- Supplier link  

\- Purchasing price including shipping  

\- Suggested selling price  

\- Expected product margin  

\- Available sizes, colours and variants  

\- Potential risks  

\- A clear recommendation and explanation  

\- Screenshots or other supporting evidence  



If information cannot be confirmed, write “not established.” Never invent numbers or present assumptions as facts.



## Google Shopping and Compliance



You must understand how product data affects Google Shopping and Google Merchant Center.



You must be able to recognize and avoid:



\- Replica and counterfeit fashion products  

\- Unauthorized brands and logos  

\- Copyrighted products  

\- Watermarked supplier images  

\- Text or promotional claims on main product images  

\- Copied competitor titles and descriptions  

\- Incorrect or misleading product information  

\- Incorrect size and colour variants  

\- Unrealistic discounts  

\- Medical or health claims  

\- Product URLs that do not match the listing  

\- Missing Google Shopping attributes  

\- Supplier names being used as the webshop vendor  



Accuracy and compliance are more important than uploading large numbers of poor-quality products.



## Required Skills



\- Demonstrable experience with fashion e-commerce stores generating at least $5,000 per day  

\- Professional experience with fashion product research  

\- Professional experience creating Shopify product listings  

\- Strong understanding of fashion categories and seasonal demand  

\- Experience using Google Keyword Planner  

\- Experience using Google Trends  

\- Knowledge of Google Shopping and Google Merchant Center  

\- Strong competitor-research skills  

\- Experience researching suppliers, prices and margins  

\- Ability to interpret data and explain product decisions  

\- Excellent written English  

\- Excellent attention to detail  

\- Ability to follow detailed SOPs and checklists  

\- Experience using AI tools without blindly trusting their output  

\- Ability to work independently  

\- Clear and reliable communication  



## Preferred Experience



\- Experience with fashion stores operating in the United States, United Kingdom or Europe  

\- Experience with general fashion or large-catalogue stores  

\- Experience with women’s fashion  

\- Experience with fashion dropshipping suppliers  

\- Experience with Google Shopping product-feed optimization  

\- Experience building seasonal fashion calendars  

\- Experience working with multiple Shopify stores  

\- Experience researching hundreds of products per month  



## What We Are Looking For



We want someone who:



\- Already knows how professional fashion product research works  

\- Understands that personal taste is not product research  

\- Can distinguish a product from a product category  

\- Uses search demand and trend data when making decisions  

\- Understands seasonal fashion demand  

\- Can recognize a promising category before it becomes saturated  

\- Does not blindly copy competitors or suppliers  

\- Can create original listings from supplier information  

\- Notices small errors before a listing is submitted  

\- Uses AI to increase productivity without sacrificing accuracy  

\- Takes responsibility for the quality of their work  

\- Is looking for a stable, long-term position  



## Performance Indicators



Your performance will be evaluated based on:



\- Quality of product recommendations  

\- Accuracy of research and calculations  

\- Profitability of selected products  

\- Performance of selected categories after launch  

\- Quality and completeness of Shopify listings  

\- Number of avoidable listing errors  

\- Compliance with our SOPs  

\- Consistency of weekly output  

\- Ability to meet agreed deadlines  

\- Quality of communication and reporting  



We value quality over volume. Uploading many weak products is not considered good performance.



## Working Arrangement



\- Remote position  

\- Long-term opportunity  

\- Approximately 20 to 40 hours per week  

\- Flexible working hours with agreed deadlines  

\- Weekly reporting and regular communication  

\- Compensation based on proven experience and ability  

\- A paid test assignment will be part of the selection process  



## Paid Test Assignment



Shortlisted candidates will receive a paid test assignment.



The assignment may include:



\- Researching one fashion category  

\- Checking search volume and trend direction  

\- Finding suitable fashion products and suppliers  

\- Comparing competitor prices  

\- Calculating the expected selling price and margin  

\- Explaining why a product should or should not be added  

\- Creating one complete Shopify product listing as a draft  



The test will evaluate both your research ability and your listing quality.



## How to Apply



Start your application with the name of your favorite fruit.



Applications that do not follow this instruction will be rejected.



Then answer all of the following questions:



1. How many years of professional fashion product-research experience do you have?

2. How many years of Shopify product-listing experience do you have?

3. Which fashion stores have you previously worked with?

4. What was the average daily or monthly revenue of these stores?

5. What was your exact role within these stores?

6. How long did you work with each store?

7. Approximately how many fashion products did you research and list each week?

8. Which countries and markets did these stores target?

9. Which fashion categories did you work with?

10. Which tools did you use for product research?

11. How do you determine whether a fashion category has sufficient demand?

12. How do you use Google Trends to d
 when products should be launched?

13. How do you calculate whether a product has sufficient margin?

14. What do you check before creating a Shopify listing?

15. How do you use AI during product research and product listing?

16. Provide an example of a fashion category or product you successfully researched.

17. Explain what happened after the product was launched.

18. Include examples of Shopify listings you personally created.

19. Include anonymized evidence of your previous results.

20. Are you willing to explain your experience through a Loom video or live screenshare?

21. Are you willing to complete a paid test assignment?

22. How many hours per week are you available?

23. What is your expected hourly rate?

24. When can you start?



Generic applications, copied answers, unverifiable claims and applications without relevant fashion experience will be rejected.

* Best and worst foods for fat loss

* Fitness tier-list videos

* High-protein food rankings

* Exercise rankings

* Fat-loss mistakes

* Why you're not losing weight

* Habits keeping men overweight

* How to structure your diet

* How to stay consistent

* Building discipline

* Building routines and structure

* Mindset around fitness

* Talking-head fitness advice



Some videos will be educational.



Some will be opinion/ranking-style content designed to generate comments.



Some will have a simple CTA at the end asking viewers to comment a keyword to receive something through ManyChat.



For example:



**"Comment LEAN and I'll send you the guide."**



The CTA will already be provided to you.



You are **not responsible for creating the marketing strategy or managing ManyChat.**



---



## Editing Style



Most videos should be relatively simple.



Typical editing may include:



* Removing mistakes and dead space

* Jump cuts

* Cleaning up pacing

* Basic audio cleanup

* Clean captions/subtitles

* Highlighting important words (If needed)

* Occasional punch-ins / zooms

* B-roll where it improves the point

* Images appearing on screen

* Screenshots appearing on screen

* Food images

* Exercise footage

* Before-and-after examples when provided

* Tier-list graphics

* Simple text graphics

* Light sound effects

* Background music when appropriate

* Clear CTA text at the end

* Proper 9:16 Instagram formatting



I do NOT want every second filled with animations (Unless needed)



The goal is to make the content **easy to watch without making the editing distracting.**



The idea, hook, and message should remain the focus.



---



## Example Editing Philosophy



If I'm talking about:



**"The 5 best foods for getting below 15% body fat"**



I may already provide the talking-head footage.



Your job might simply be to:



1. Cut out pauses and mistakes.

2. Add clean captions.

3. Display each food as I mention it.

4. Add an image of the food.

5. Add light zooms/punch-ins where appropriate.

6. Add simple sound effects if necessary.

7. Show the CTA clearly at the end.



That's it.



I value **good judgment and restraint**.



More editing does not automatically mean better editing.



---



# Content Funnel



You should understand that most of this content will be **top-of-funnel and middle-of-funnel content**.



The objective is to:



**Get attention → provide value → create engagement → generate comments → move interested viewers into my fitness coaching funnel.**



You will NOT be expected to develop this strategy.



However, understanding the purpose of the content will help you make better editing decisions.



The Reel needs to keep attention without distracting from the message or CTA.



---



## Expected Volume



### Phase 1 — First 90 Days



We will initially produce approximately:



**5–7 Reels per week**



However, the starting monthly commitment will generally be around:



**20–25 Reels per month.**



If we work well together and the content produces results, the workload can increase toward:



**25–30+ Reels per month.**



I'm looking for someone interested in consistent, recurring work rather than random one-off projects.



---



## Compensation



Starting compensation is:



**$12–$15 USD per completed Reel.**



Most videos will be simple talking-head edits.



Videos requiring substantially more editing, graphics, B-roll, or custom work may be compensated differently when agreed upon beforehand.



The initial relationship will begin with a **paid test edit**.



If the quality, communication, turnaround time, and reliability are strong, I want to develop this into a long-term working relationship.



As the business grows and responsibilities increase, compensation can increase as well.



---



## Turnaround Time



Standard turnaround should generally be:



**24–48 hours.**



Footage will often be delivered in batches so you can work efficiently.



Reliability is extremely important.



I don't want to chase someone every week asking when videos will be finished.



---



## Revisions



Most videos should require minimal revisions once you understand the editing style.



Initially, there may be more feedback while we establish the system.



You should be comfortable receiving direct feedback and making reasonable revisions.



The goal is eventually to develop a repeatable editing system where you already know how I want the content edited.



---



# Ideal Candidate



You are a strong fit if you:



* Have experience editing Instagram Reels

* Have experience with talking-head content

* Understand short-form pacing

* Understand captions and subtitle placement

* Know when to use B-roll and when NOT to use it

* Can find simple images/B-roll when necessary

* Understand fitness content

* Can follow reference videos closely

* Communicate clearly

* Deliver work consistently

* Follow deadlines

* Respond well to feedback

* Pay attention to details

* Want ongoing work

* Can maintain the same editing style across dozens of videos



You do NOT need to be an advanced motion graphics editor.



I care much more about:



**Reliability + Speed + Taste + Following Instructions**



than complicated editing.



---



# Software



Preferred:



* CapCut Desktop / CapCut Pro

* Adobe Premiere Pro

* DaVinci Resolve



Other professional editing software is acceptable.



---



# Paid Test



Before selecting the long-term editor, I will hire a few candidates for a small paid test.



Everyone will receive similar raw footage and instructions.



The test will primarily evaluate:



* Editing quality

* Pacing

* Captions

* Visual choices

* Ability to follow instructions

* Communication

* Turnaround time



This is a **paid test**, not free spec work.



---



# How To Apply



Please send the following:



1. Your name

2. Your location

3. Your primary editing software

4. How long you've been editing short-form content

5. Links to your **3 best short-form videos**

6. Examples of talking-head content you've edited

7. Your typical turnaround time for a 30–90 second Reel

8. How many Reels you could reliably edit each week

9. Whether you're comfortable working at the starting rate of **$10–$12 per Reel**

10. Why you're interested in consistent long-term work



Then answer this question:



**If someone is talking to the camera for 60 seconds, what would you do to keep the video interesting without over-editing it?**



At the very top of your application, write:



**COMEBACK**



If you do not include **COMEBACK** at the beginning of your application, I will assume you did not read the full posting.



I'm looking for an editor I can build a long-term system with as the brand and business grow.

title: My unicorn VA + Video editor and much more (Tarot Business)
description:
Hello Beautiful Soul and possible VA.



**Please read everything before applying**



In the process of starting a Tarot and Psychic Business which will be based on Tarot Readings and pick a card YouTube videos on YouTube I am looking for my Absolute unicorn VA that I can really grow with and accomplish and succeed with. I am planing to launch within the next week so with me on the team I’m excited to find my new bestie that gets me, that gets my vision and that feels like MY person that I can have so much fun with.



I'm so excited to announce this position and to find my dream VA for my new (not started yet) psychic business which I intuitively feel will hit FAST & BIG. And whoever I choose as my DREAM VA here will grow with me on this exciting journey.



We maybe start smaller but my goal in this is that YOU will grow with me and expand as the business and success expands.



I have so many plans and ideas which we can chat about when we chat personally in WhatsApp if I choose to reach out to you:)



Firstly let me introduce myself, my name is Antonette Kvalsvik and I will soon start and publish “The Royal Seer” a brand that will be about creating readings, pick a card videos, posts and as it grows we will do a lot more. Actually one night I was watching a movie with my partner and this suddenly came through me, over a year ago and it hasn’t disappeared and have been with me all along like a inner push like I’m meant to create and to follow this calling.



My inner deep feeling is telling me that within 1-2 months this will blow up and become something deep and soul fulfilling and I'm so excited to start this journey with someone who just match with me in every level!!



I have many tasks I want to have done and I respect that maybe you don't know how to do it all, I am therefore willing to hire a couple of people that can do different things so read properly through what l desire and see which tasks you feel guided to and feel excited about.



IMPORTANT: My main tasks will be Video editing and Graphic design so I will priorities people who can do that and then we can add other task into that then to hirer someone who can’t do those and only other things, this business isn’t launched yet so it’s limited how many I can hirer so because of that video editors and graphic designers will be prioritized.



VIDEO EDITOR - Most important task of it all is that I desire a video editor to Really Edit my videos, you can search on "Pick a card videos" on YouTube to see what kind of vidoes I'm thinking about before you apply. I need you to edit my long form videos and create reels, promos, shorts and everything around editing. I will prefer that you use a more develop program like “Adobe” or something else, I’m not really believing in CapCut because it’s not so good at sound and voice editing, but if you know a way or you combine two programs to make it good and mean that CapCut is enough I am willing to talk about it and see if we can give it a go. The most important thing is that you are creative because if you have that sparkling creation I’m looking for whatever program you use you will manage it because you have this artistic vibe and energy within you. I trust in YOU and not your program.



EXPERIENCE : I guess I am a bit different when it comes to experience because I don’t need or even care if you have 10 years or 6 months or experience, after interviewing a lot of people I have meet people who have 5+ years of video editing experience that couldn’t create my vision because they don’t get what I’m doing or they are not spiritually creative in the way I need (they are good just not for the subject I’m creating) so honestly I don’t care about experience, I look at what you can create for me and not what you have done before.



IMPORTANT : When you apply and I feel drawn to you and give you my WhatsApp number I will ask you to create a SAMPLE video edit (don’t need to be long) and a graphic this is for me to see if we are a match and if our vision matches, this isn’t paid so if you aren’t willing to do that I won’t go further and you won’t be hired. With so many applications I won’t hire without that. And it’s no point sending me portfolio as I won’t look at that, I will look at your text in the application and feel on if I want to talk more or not. And if I want to then you hear from me!



So in the middle of all this to make sure you read everything I have a code word which is “Hallo” and if you write that in your application you definitely will hear from me haha.



GRAPHIC DESIGN : This part is SO important and I love to see beautiful graphics, I don’t really care which programs you use because if you are creative you will be able to put together a beautiful graphic that fits The Royal Seer. Tasks with the Graphic Design would be to create IG carousel posts, YouTube designs and generally different designs. You need to have a creative sense in you and trust your intuition as you are creating!!



WRITING - Writing will be a big thing in this business, example when I create a pick a card video then I want you write it out simple as a carousel post so let’s say my pick a card video is “Rest of 2026 prediction” then you take the main things I’m saying and creating a post out of it, use all the content we can to make it beautiful and magical. Other writings will be description under YouTube videos, edit post I’m writing for social media like Instagram, description of each social media, description of readings I will offer and other things coming up.



I understand that you don’t know how to do everything, but that’s why I desire a creative person that can do their research and figure things out and be willing to try to “jump” into new things and trust their intuition.



SOCIAL MEDIA - I am planing to have IG, fb, Pinterest and TikTok to post both reels, posts etc so l need someone to handle it, post, grow and all the things. We figure this part out! All I know is that we will grow in fast speed, I see this vision so clearly intuitively and I’m so excited to find you!



I desire someone who I feel is my friend as we are working, I don't like this boss/VA relationship, I want someone that I can have fun working with, someone who are creative, coming with ideas, wants to grow as much as me, someone who love to chat and to create and just figure things out as we go and that get me and this business. I want to feel like this is a project we create and grow together in!



Example I can imagine us sitting and creating a reel and you coming up with ideas like “I have this vision what if I try it like this” and I will say go for it and then the result gets amazing.



I am impulsive and sudden ideas may come through so I want to work with someone who is fast and effective, who I don't have to sit around and wait for a reply on, someone who can work in weekends and weekdays when ideas and work is desired to get done, someone who isn't slow in answering and someone who is fully into the process and wants to grow just as much as I want to!!

I will pay you weekly through PayPal and we will agree on a minimum payment, that means that no matter what you will always get paid your minimum the day we agree it’s payment day (unless you haven’t work for a week) but some time you will get more as I can and we are creating a lot. I don't pay pr hours, we will agree on a set price and I would never want to work with someone who doesn't feel good with an amount we agree on as I never want you to settle or lower your worth so if we don't match on the same price then we won't work together as this is important to have it good, but we will figure it all out as we connect and talk.
